offers.title: Senior ML Engineer (R14284)
offers.description: Headquarters: Remote - India Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. A Quick Note on the Role's Focus While the title is Senior ML Engineer , this opportunity is specifically focused on ML Platform Engineering rather than ML model development or data science. We're looking for engineers with strong software engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience building, scaling, and operating the platforms and infrastructure that enable machine learning in production. The emphasis is on ML infrastructure, MLOps, model serving, platform reliability, and production engineering , rather than primarily developing, training, or fine-tuning ML models. Location Note We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position, the role must be performed from within India. The Opportunity The Machine Learning Platform team builds the software foundations that enable data scientists and machine learning engineers to develop, validate, deploy, and operate models safely and efficiently in production. In this role, you’ll lead complex platform work from business context through production outcomes, combining hands-on engineering, architectural judgment, production ownership, and mentorship. In your first year, success means leading meaningful platform initiatives, improving reliability and developer experience, and becoming a trusted technical leader for the ML platform. At Oportun, we move fast and hold each other to a high bar. You’ll partner across Data Science, Product, Risk, Fraud, and Engineering to solve ambiguous problems and move the needle for members and the business. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You’ll lead the design, implementation, deployment, and operation of complex platform capabilities that support the machine-learning lifecycle. You’ll design scalable systems for model deployment and serving, feature computation, data validation, workflow orchestration, monitoring, and production support. You’ll build reusable platform components, standards, and automation while improving reliability, scalability, observability, and operational readiness across ML systems. You’ll partner with Data Science, Product, Risk, Fraud, and Engineering teams to translate ambiguous business needs into practical technical solutions. You’ll own significant technical initiatives end to end and lead complex production investigations—clarifying requirements, leading design, delivering safely, measuring results, and implementing durable fixes. You’ll raise engineering quality through thoughtful code and design reviews, mentor engineers through pairing and technical guidance, and contribute to platform technical strategy. You’ll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster. Who You Are The right fit looks like this You do not need detailed implementation direction to be effective. Given an ambiguous problem and sufficient context, you can define the technical approach, explain trade-offs, align stakeholders, lead delivery, and own the outcome after launch. You’re comfortable navigating complexity and don’t wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, mentor others, and connect engineering work to member, business, and operational outcomes. What You Bring Skills & experience You’ll have 5+ years of professional software-engineering experience building and operating production systems, with strong programming skills in Python and deep knowledge of API design, distributed systems, service architecture, testing, and software-design fundamentals. You’ve demonstrated experience designing and operating reliable, scalable cloud-native services or data-intensive systems, with experience in ML platforms, model serving, feature engineering, data platforms, MLOps, or related systems. You bring practical experience with SQL, databases, caching, and tracing data or requests across multiple systems, plus familiarity with the ML lifecycle from feature engineering and model training through evaluation, deployment, serving, monitoring, and governance. You have experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Git-based workflows, and production observability, and you can evaluate technical alternatives and clearly communicate recommendations, trade-offs, risks, and dependencies. You’ve demonstrated the ability to mentor engineers, improve engineering practices, lead through technical influence, and connect engineering work to member, business, product, and operational outcomes. Nice to Have Experience with AWS, Databricks, MLflow, SageMaker, Spark/PySpark, Kafka, or streaming systems. Experience building feature platforms, model-serving systems, workflow-orchestration platforms, or internal developer platforms. Familiarity with monitoring model quality, data quality, feature coverage, latency, reliability, or cost efficiency, and experience working with sensitive data in a regulated or financial-services environment. Experience with Java or another backend language in addition to Python, and familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT or Copilot to improve personal productivity. Our AI Mindset We b uild with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together . Why Oportun What's in it for you Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: India Benefits: Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance Provident Fund Life & Accident Insurance Internet, Fuel, Meal & Telephone Allowances Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers #LI-REMOTE #LI-SS1 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ . We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on the GitLab Orbit team, you'll help build and operate a graph data service that supports GitLab Duo agents, analytics, and architecture-level features across GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments. You'll join a Rust-first team that values clear ownership, thoughtful system design, and rigorous thinking about data and reliability. The Knowledge Graph service is a Rust backend that builds a property graph from GitLab’s software development lifecycle (SDLC) and code data. It uses ClickHouse, NATS JetStream, and the Data Insights Platform. It exposes secure graph queries and MCP tools used by AI agents and product features. In this role, you’ll deliver features and improvements in well-scoped areas, learn the broader architecture, and contribute to reliability, observability, and operational readiness. In your first year, you’ll take clear ownership of specific components or features (for example, parts of the SDLC indexing pipeline or query paths). What you’ll do Implement and iterate on backend features in the Rust-based Knowledge Graph service, including changes to the query engine, SDLC and code indexing flows, and API endpoints (including MCP endpoints) under guidance from senior and staff engineers. Maintain integrations between Knowledge Graph and the rest of the GitLab platform, working in areas that touch GitLab Rails, the Data Insights Platform (Siphon, NATS, ClickHouse), and GitLab Duo Agent Platform. Contribute to system design discussions by proposing options, raising questions, and documenting decisions, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and maintainability for analytical graph workloads. Improve the operational maturity of the service by adding or enhancing metrics, logging, runbooks, alerts, and small readiness tasks, and by participating in on-call rotation as appropriate for your level and experience. Collaborate asynchronously with product, data, infrastructure, security, and AI counterparts to clarify requirements, align on scope, and ship features safely for customers and sustainably for the team. Use AI-assisted development workflows responsibly (for example, using Knowledge Graph-backed agents and internal Duo tooling), and share what works with the team while keeping a strong focus on code quality and correctness. Participate in code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and pairing to both learn from others and help maintain consistent standards across the codebase. Contribute across the stack when needed, including occasional Ruby work for Rails integration and authorization paths, or small frontend changes related to Knowledge Graph features (for example, Software Architecture Map UI plumbing). What you’ll bring Professional experience building and maintaining backend systems in production, with an understanding of reliability, maintainability, and how to support services over time (for example, incident response and follow-ups). Proficiency in at least one modern backend language and strong interest in Rust, with either prior Rust experience or clear evidence you can ramp quickly and deliver in a Rust-first, performance-sensitive codebase. Some exposure to distributed data or analytics systems (for example, OLAP databases, Kafka- or NATS-style messaging, or change data capture (CDC) pipelines), or strong motivation to develop those skills in this role. Interest in graph data modeling and query patterns (property graphs, multi-step (n-hop) traversals, aggregations), and willingness to learn the tools and concepts used in Knowledge Graph over time. Practical experience (or strong interest) using AI tools in day-to-day development, along with a thoughtful approach to validating outputs and integrating AI into your workflow. A language-agnostic mindset and evidence that you can pick up new languages and frameworks as needed (for example, Ruby, Go, or TypeScript/Vue where the work touches adjacent systems). Solid fundamentals in system design for your level, including the ability to reason about trade-offs, ask good questions, and align your implementation work with documented architectural decisions. Comfort working in a low-process, high-ownership environment where you take responsibility for your work, refine problem statements with teammates, and communicate progress clearly in writing across time zones in an all-remote team. Job responsibilities are grouped across four key areas: Technical Integrations, Customer-Centric Consulting, Legion Product Expertise, and a Commitment to One Another. Team Collaboration & Mentorship Share expertise and mentor junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge-sharing. Commit to high-quality work, setting personal and team objectives aligned with organizational goals. Standard shift working hours: 0900-1800 This role involves participation in on-call rotation. This role may require work outside of normal business hours. REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS 7+ years of business/information/solution/technical architecture experience Graduate of a university with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant STEM field, including Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or another relevant degree Must be able to work as a team player, yet can work independently. Analytical, results-driven, and have a solution-oriented approach Possess exceptional interpersonal and English communication skills, including verbal, written presentation, and listening. 3+ years of experience with event-driven Architecture and Microservices Demonstrated deep technical expertise in Integration technologies and protocols such as HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SFTP, SOAP, REST, JMS, JDBC Experience using Linux/Unix environments Demonstrate proficiency with Core Java. Experience with Relational Databases, SQL and JDBC (one of Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, etc.) 2+ years of experience using AWS technologies such as AWS CDK, Cloud formation, S3, ECS, EKS, and EC2 Demonstrate experience with test-driven development. Strong experience with Java/RESTful web services Exposure to agile software development leveraging toolsets (e.g., Jira, GitHub, Jenkins) Demonstrate knowledge and experience with CI/CD processes and tools. Proven track record of using problem-solving / root-cause analysis PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES The ideal candidate has workforce management integration experience Preferred experience in the design and implementation of scalable integration solutions with integration platforms such as Workato, SAP BTP Integration Suite, Dell Boomi, Jitterbit, SnapLogic Proactive and able to command respect through intelligence, hard work, and persistence Technical consulting experience. Experience of working with Docker and other isolation technologies. Experience working with external applications integrations end-to-end such as Workday, SAP, etc. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. Benefits include, but are not limited to: Health Benefits Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays Parental Leave Equity Monthly Wellness Reimbursement Monthly Lunch on Legion ABOUT LEGION Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love. If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling. BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. offers.description: Headquarters: Sarasota, FL URL: https://www.simpletiger.com/ SimpleTiger is hiring a part-time contract web developer to build, improve, and troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot, with the potential to grow into a larger role. We’re a B2B SaaS marketing agency helping software companies grow through SEO, content marketing, paid media, and answer engine optimization (AEO). Our clients’ websites are where much of that work comes to life, and we’re looking for a developer who can turn ideas into clean, functional pages quickly. As part of our delivery team, you’ll work primarily on client websites, translating designs, campaign concepts, and SEO recommendations into effective web experiences. From building new pages to fixing issues on existing sites, you’ll help turn our marketing strategy into work that’s ready to launch. Key responsibilities Build, update, or troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot CMS Make technical fixes and improvements to live client sites, with clear details on what was tested, implemented, and performance comparisons using tools like Screaming Frog, pagespeed insights, and Lighthouse Build and connect forms, lead routing, and simple automations between a site and the client’s marketing tools Set up and check tracking, like GA4, Google Tag Manager, and HubSpot tracking in Tandem with the SEO Manager Keep sites fast, accessible, and friendly to SEO (page speed, Core Web Vitals, clean markup, image optimizations, cache lifetime improvements, and so on) Write clear and timely notes on what you are actively working on, and any updates pushed live so our team and the client can follow along Qualifications and skills You’re a hands-on developer who can build from scratch, troubleshoot existing sites, and make improvements without disrupting what’s already working. Required skills WordPress development: Strong experience with custom themes, child themes, blocks, page builders, and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF). You can build a page from the ground up—not just edit an existing one. HubSpot CMS development: Strong experience with HubL templates, modules, and themes, including building and troubleshooting pages, forms, and email templates. Front-end development: Solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript skills, with the ability to navigate existing code and understand how changes affect the live site. APIs and integrations: Experience working with the HubSpot or WordPress REST APIs, plus CRMs and marketing tools such as Salesforce, Zapier, n8n, Airtable, and Slack. Technical audits and fixes: Experience using Screaming Frog to audit WordPress and HubSpot sites, interpret findings, and resolve technical issues. Code review and cleanup: Comfort working within WordPress and HubSpot codebases to identify legacy or unused JavaScript and CSS, determine what’s still needed, and safely remove what isn’t. Async communication: Clear, timely written communication, especially through Slack. Independent work: Strong time management and the ability to meet deadlines, flag blockers early, and keep projects moving without close supervision. Nice-to-have skills Webflow development and auditing experience, including building a clean CMS structure. PHP development experience. Previous work at a marketing agency or with B2B SaaS clients. Familiarity with SEO and conversion best practices. Experience with Git and version control. What success looks like Success means delivering clean, reliable development work that helps our team turn marketing plans into live client experiences. Designs, campaign concepts, and SEO requests become functional pages in WordPress and HubSpot. Technical audit findings lead to practical fixes, with changes tested to avoid breaking existing functionality. Legacy and unused code is cleaned up thoughtfully, while essential code and front-end behavior remain intact. Forms, templates, and integrations work as intended and support the client’s marketing workflows. Projects stay on track because you manage your workload, meet agreed deadlines, and raise questions or blockers early. Teammates have clear visibility into progress through timely updates and straightforward communication in Slack. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/simpletiger-web-developer-wordpress-hubspot-u-s-based-remote-contractor

Experience working with remote, geographically distributed teams. Previous experience at a high-growth technology company. Your mastery of a technical domain enables you to take up business problems and solve them with a technical solution. With your depth of expertise and leadership abilities, you will actively contribute to architectural decisions, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable software solutions that advance our impact in the market. At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You’ll design and implement scalable, efficient, and reliable data architectures that support business and analytical needs. You’ll build and maintain data pipelines, ETL processes, and integration solutions for large volumes of structured and unstructured data. You’ll optimize data pipelines, databases, data warehouses, and data lakes for performance, reliability, scalability, and security. You’ll partner with stakeholders to understand data requirements, develop domain expertise, and translate business needs into effective data models and solutions. You’ll establish and improve data quality standards, validation rules, documentation, and governance practices. You’ll implement monitoring and observability practices to identify bottlenecks, improve performance, and strengthen platform reliability. You’ll provide technical leadership on architecture, scalability, reliability, monitoring, integration, and extensibility. You’ll lead and contribute to code reviews, helping maintain high standards for code quality, performance, and maintainability. You’ll mentor junior engineers and support a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. You’ll take ownership of production issues, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, escalation, and long-term resolution. You’ll independently lead multiple features and projects, coordinate work across engineers, and keep stakeholders informed of progress, risks, and dependencies. You’ll help evolve engineering tools, platforms, and practices and encourage adoption of better ways of working. You’ll look for practical ways to use AI tools to improve engineering productivity, analysis, documentation, and problem-solving. Who You Are The right fit looks like this You’re a hands-on data engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building systems that others depend on. You combine strong technical depth with a practical understanding of business needs and know how to turn ambiguous requirements into scalable solutions. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are comfortable leading technical work without relying on formal authority. You enjoy mentoring others and helping teams make stronger technical decisions. What You Bring Skills & experience Required 8+ years of experience in data engineering, with strong experience in data architecture, ETL, and database management. Strong programming skills in Python or PySpark, plus experience with Java or Scala. Experience building complex end-to-end data pipelines and data integration solutions. Strong knowledge of SQL and experience with relational and NoSQL database technologies. Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, or similar platforms. Experience with orchestration and scheduling tools such as Airflow, Databricks, Jenkins, or similar technologies. Experience designing and operating scalable, reliable, and secure data systems. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and associated data services. Experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum, Lean, or Kanban. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to technical leadership within a team. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams. Nice to Have Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. Databricks experience or certification. Experience with AWS Redshift, S3, Azure SQL Data Warehouse, or comparable cloud data services. Experience implementing data governance, data quality, or observability frameworks. Experience leading cross-functional or multi-month engineering initiatives. Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development, troubleshooting, documentation, or productivity. Our AI Mindset We build with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together. offers.title: VFX Artist
offers.description: We’re looking for talented VFX Artists to join the Eleons team! We’re looking for artists who can bring abilities, attacks, and visual effects to life with high-quality, polished visuals that fit our game’s art style. Requirements Strong Drawing & Sketching Skills — Ability to sketch out VFX concepts or provide clear visual references and ideas for how an effect should look. Creative Visualization — Ability to communicate your ideas through sketches, references, or rough concepts before moving into production. Custom Asset Creation — Ability to create your own assets for VFX rather than relying entirely on pre-made assets. Texturing Skills — Experience creating custom textures for effects, including the ability to design and produce textures from scratch. Strong Artistic Eye — Understanding of color, shape, lighting, timing, and visual impact to create appealing and readable effects. What We’re Looking For We’re looking for people who can take an idea from concept to execution. You should be able to visualize an effect, sketch or communicate the concept, create the necessary assets and textures, and turn it into a polished VFX effect in-game. When applying, please include: Your portfolio or previous VFX work. Examples of your sketches or VFX concepts, if available. Examples of custom assets and textures you’ve created. A brief description of the tools you use and your experience. Softwares you should be familiar with Adobe Animate, Blender, Illugen, Houdini, Embergen, Pixel Composer, Photoshop/Krita Please only apply if you have relevant work to showcase. We’re looking for artists who can demonstrate both creativity and technical ability.

offers.title: VFX Artist
offers.description: Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen. EA Create EA Create is a collective of content production teams partnering with EA Studios game teams to bring outstanding visuals, audio and technology to life. Our teams consist of artists, engineers, technicians, designers and development directors. Worldwide, we combine our teams to form a global group of extraordinary individuals fueled by imagination and a unified passion for creating amazing visuals, sound and experiences. We’re a diverse team that is unified through collaboration, culture and craft. Role Overview We are looking for a VFX Artistto join our team in Shanghai and help bring the next chapter of FPS multiplayer maps to life. You will work within proprietary tools and engines, alongside real-time node workflows, to create highly realistic, photorealistic, and high-impact visual effects. Your core focus will be creating immersive environmental atmospheres for multiplayer levels and authoring dynamic, physics-based prop/structural destruction. You will collaborate with VFX, Art Direction, Design, Engineering, Technical Art, Production, and overseas partner studios to deliver top-tier visual effects within real-time engine memory, performance, and platform constraints. This is a junior-to-mid level role suited for an artist with a solid foundation in real-time game VFX and offline simulation (Houdini), who is eager to grow within a premier AAA environment, communicate across disciplines, and contribute directly to Battlefield's destruction visual language. Responsibilities Real-Time VFX Production: Create photorealistic interpretations of real-world visual effects that fit FPS game’s mature visual tone, environmental scale, and performance targets. Map & Destruction Effects: Produce real-time VFX for a wide range of multiplayer map content, including high-intensity explosions, complex building/object destruction sequences, rigid-body fracturing, debris splinters, dynamic fire/smoke, and ambient weather states (rain, dust, wind). Engine Integration: Work within proprietary engine tools and pipelines (including Frostbite and Unreal Niagara) to implement, test, inspect, debug, and polish in-game VFX. VFX Building Blocks: Use emitters, fluid simulations, custom animated textures, meshes, dynamic materials, lighting, and math/logic-based node graphs to build high-quality real-time effects. Cross-Discipline Collaboration: Partner closely with local VFX team members, Technical Art, Environment Art, Modeling, Lighting, Audio, and overseas design/engineering stakeholders to achieve gameplay readability and aesthetic goals. Gameplay Support: Ensure all map destruction and volumetric smoke/fire support the visual gameplay language, maintaining appropriate cover readability and player silhouette contrast. Performance & Optimization: Create assets within strict real-time memory and GPU performance constraints (e.g., managing particle counts, overdraw, and vertex budgets) for multi-platform PC and console delivery. Organization & Pipelines: Maintain clean asset file structures, ShotGrid/Jira tracking, strict naming conventions, and follow version-control guidelines (Perforce). Qualifications 3+ years of professional experience as a VFX Artist in the video game or film/cinematic simulation industry. Proven experience contributing to game production pipelines using real-time VFX tools; console/PC action or shooter experience is highly preferred. Hands-on experience creating realistic real-time assets using particle emitters, static/dynamic textures, meshes, custom materials, and shader graphs. Strong working knowledge of Houdini (RBD, Pyro, fluid solvers) for simulation bakes, VAT (Vertex Animation Textures), and flipbook sheet creation. Good foundational knowledge of Maya, Photoshop, After Effects / Nuke , and dynamic node-based material editors. Solid understanding of photorealistic VFX fundamentals, including real-world physical scale, natural lighting/exposure, dynamic timing, and energy curves (forces, velocity, weight, and dissipate behaviors). Understanding of real-time performance considerations such as fill rate, transparency overdraw, shader complexity, particle spawn rates, and target platform constraints. Strong communication and collaboration skills to sync with multi-discipline teams and international partner studios. Good English communication skills for written updates, ticketing systems, documentation, and feedback reviews. A mindset focused on high artistic standards, collaboration, open learning, accountability, and continuous self-improvement. Bonus Qualifications Familiarity with the franchise, first-person shooters (FPS), or large-scale multiplayer war games. Experience in creating environmental destruction networks, impact interactions, weather fx, or vehicle destruction setups. Familiarity with EmberGen, FumeFX, PhoenixFD, or other modern real-time fluid generators. Experience with Unreal Niagara, Blueprint visual scripting, or dynamic material function shaders. Experience using GPU profiling, performance analysis, or in-engine debugging tools. Experience writing automation scripts (Python, PyMEL, or VEX) to optimize artist pipelines. Experience working with distributed, multilingual, or cross-time-zone teams. About Electronic Arts We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth. We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do. Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

offers.title: Lead VFX Artist
offers.description: About Gameloft Here at Gameloft, we create moments of happiness for our players all over the world through exciting gaming experiences. This is our mission, and it has been the same for over 25 years. We are the proud creators of Asphalt, Dungeon Hunter, Modern Combat, and over 200 other great games. There is a game for everyone, and we are now expanding to cross-platform games on PC and consoles, with titles such as Disney Speedstorm and Disney Dreamlight Valley, to provide our players with even more amazing adventures. With more than 3,000 passionate Gamelofters across the globe, we take great pride in our differences and draw on them to create games just as diverse as we are. If you’re looking for a new challenge and want to work with a bold and talented group of people, don’t hesitate to join the game! WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON Main challenge We are looking for a Lead VFX Artist to lead the VFX discipline across our games, combining strong artistic expertise with team coordination, visual direction, and pipeline development. You will work closely with the Art Director and key stakeholders across the studio to ensure a consistent visual and technical quality across all VFX, while supporting project and studio goals. You will oversee the VFX process from initial concepts and prototyping through implementation, iteration, optimisation, and final delivery. Working with our proprietary engine and in-house tools, you will also contribute to the evolution of our VFX workflows, standards, and technology. What it means on a daily basis VFX Team Leadership: Oversee and coordinate the VFX team, establish priorities, and ensure deadlines and quality targets are met. Identify and remove systemic blockers early and proactively adjust resources and scope. Visual Direction & Quality: Work with the Art Director to ensure visual and technical unity across all VFX. Review completed work against artistic, technical, and gameplay requirements and advance VFX quality through regular reviews. Cross-Team Collaboration: Collaborate with Art Leads, Producers, Gameplay, Tech Art, Engineering, and other teams. Provide constructive feedback to internal and external partners. VFX Pipeline: Oversee the entire VFX pipeline, from initial concept and prototyping through implementation, iteration, optimisation, and final delivery. Standards & Workflows: Establish and maintain VFX standards, workflows, tools, and best practices. Ensure effects meet performance and platform requirements. Team Development: Participate in recruitment, mentor VFX artists, and foster team growth and development. What success will look like After 3 months, you will have built a strong understanding of the studio's projects, VFX workflows, team structure, and production requirements. You will have established effective working relationships with the Art Director and key stakeholders across the studio. After 6 months, you will be independently driving VFX priorities, supporting the team in delivering against project goals, and contributing to the evolution of VFX standards, workflows, and quality across the studio. Who you would be working with You will report to the Studio Art Director and work closely with VFX artists, Art Leads, Producers, Gameplay, Tech Art, Engineering, and other art and development teams. You will also collaborate with internal and external partners throughout the production process. Your recruitment journey HR Screen Call Test Second Interview Final Interview Where this role can take you This role can offer opportunities to deepen your expertise in VFX leadership, expand your responsibilities across the wider art discipline, and contribute to the development of VFX standards, workflows, and technology. You will also have access to development opportunities, mentorship, coaching, or internal mobility depending on business and individual opportunities. WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED Demonstrated advanced expertise in real-time VFX for games, supported by a strong portfolio. Strong knowledge of visual effects techniques for creating real-time VFX in a 3D game engine. Strong knowledge of industry-standard game engines such as Unity, Unreal Engine, or CryEngine. Solid understanding of game development and how VFX contribute to gameplay, visual feedback, and the overall player experience. Experience creating particle systems and VFX in 3D packages such as Maya, Houdini, or 3ds Max. Experience with VFX techniques and plugins for 3D software packages such as RayFire, Krakatoa, FumeFX, AfterBurn, or Maya Fluids. Ability to establish priorities, manage workflows, and coordinate a VFX team while maintaining quality and delivery standards. Ability to take initiative, provide creative input, and positively accept and apply feedback. Willingness to work with in-house tools and contribute to the development and improvement of proprietary game technology. Expertise in GLSL or HLSL would be beneficial. Previous experience in mobile game development would be a plus. Some experience with animation would also be a plus. Fluent professional English, written and spoken, for collaboration in an international environment. WHO YOU ARE You are a creative and experienced VFX professional who can combine artistic vision with an understanding of production and technical requirements. You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with different disciplines and stakeholders. You are comfortable giving and receiving constructive feedback and using it to improve both your own work and the team's output. You can organise priorities, identify blockers, and proactively find solutions in a production environment. You are interested in developing people, processes, and workflows alongside the quality of the VFX itself. Why Join the World of Gameloft? Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing! Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers! Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries & cultures! Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace! Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work! Benefits Permanent contract and full-time position with excellent social benefits. 25 vacation days per year. Private medical health insurance. Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card. Flexible work-from-home hybrid model. Free language courses. Your birthday off! 2 months of remote work. Merit-based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package. Career development opportunities. Excellent working conditions, with our office located in the centre of Barcelona. ...and Thursday after-work beers! Salary range (based on responsibilities, experience, internal equity and market benchmarks): 65k-75k gross/year Applicable Collective Agreement: Comercio del Metal de Barcelona We can’t wait to find our next great talent! Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us! Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted and your CV will be saved in our files for a period of 6 months. Want to know more? Please visit our Website: www.gameloft.com If the offer interests you, Join the Game!

offers.title: Principal VFX Artist - Unpublished R&D Product
offers.location: Los Angeles, North America, USA, California, Mercer Island, Washington
offers.description: As part of the Real-Time VFX team, you’ll design and help implement the sleek, dynamic and dramatic special effects that add atmosphere and depth to gameplay. With your experience, you’ll create aesthetically captivating visual effects that communicate essential game information. You’ll use your artistic and technical skills to breathe life into undead spells, channel primal emotions and capture the essence of hundreds of champions. As a Principal VFX Artist on the unpublished MMO team, you will be responsible for driving the style of our real-time VFX systems and pipelines. This role focuses on artistic problem solving while collaborating with Tech Art to create scalable, modular systems that will support our open world, content, and gameplay for years to come. VFX in our game is foundational. It’s not just a layer of polish; it shapes gameplay clarity, gameplay feedback, and the identity of the world itself. You'll partner across Design, Animation, and Engineering to prototype abilities, define visual language hierarchies, and create reusable systems that support thousands of effects across characters, environments, and interactions. Responsibilities : Own and steward the artistic quality bar for real-time VFX, setting clear benchmarks for style, craft, readability, and consistency across the game. Personally author benchmark effects that demonstrate the intended visual language across characters, environments, and world interactions. Establish visual hierarchy principles and partner with Design and Animation to make abilities, impacts, and other gameplay events clear in complex encounters. Partner with Tech Art and Engineering to turn the artistic benchmarks into reusable VFX patterns, modular workflows, and tools that support both rapid prototyping and production. Collaborate with Tech Art and Engineering to profile effects and define practical performance and scalability targets for open world spaces and different quality settings. Represent VFX in cross-discipline reviews and planning - communicating tradeoffs, guiding adoption of the visual standards, and helping unblock teams without implying that this role alone owns technical architecture or people management. Required Qualifications : 8+ years of experience creating real-time VFX for AAA games. Strong experience working within Unreal Engine and using skills such as Niagara, Blueprint, Niagara Scratchpad, and Material Graphs. Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, readability, and prioritization in complex gameplay spaces. Experience with modular and systemic VFX development, creating reusable effects that scale across large environments. Familiarity with performance optimization for large scale battles and high density environments. Experience shipping at least one AAA game title. Desired Qualifications : Experience working on MMOs or large-scale multiplayer games, with a focus on readability and system scalability Experience with Houdini, Blender, Substance Designer, Adobe Animate, After Effects, Photoshop, Maya, or 3DS Max. Familiarity with Python or other programming languages such as C++, C#, Python, Houdini’s VEX, HLSL, etc Familiarity with scalable large world-building workflows Experience with performance benchmarking, streaming budgets, and optimization in large-scale maps When submitting your application, please provide a portfolio of high-quality real-time VFX work, including examples of systematic thinking, stylized effects, technical implementation, and gameplay-focused VFX. For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise and a collaborative spirit that prioritizes the delight of players. We will look at your past studies and experience, but for this role, we also look for dedicated people with a personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this is the role for you! Our Perks: Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k with company match. Check out our benefits pages for more information. At Riot Games, we put players first . That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application. It’s our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and members of Riot Games, Inc. Riot Games makes reasonable accommodations for handicapped and disabled Rioters and does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, handicap, veteran status, marital status, criminal history, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law. We consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including the California Fair Chance Act, the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the Washington Fair Chance Act. Per the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the following core duties may create a basis for disqualifying candidates with relevant criminal histories: Safeguarding confidential and sensitive Company data Communication with others, including Rioters and third parties such as vendors, and/or players, including minors Accessing Company assets, secure digital systems, and networks Ensuring a safe interactive environment for players and other Rioters These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. Please note that job duties may evolve based on business needs and additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to maintain operational efficiency and security.

offers.title: Blizzard 2027 Summer Internships - VFX
offers.description: Team Name Job Title: Blizzard 2027 Summer Internships - VFX Requisition ID: R028376 Job Description: Blizzard is looking for talented and innovative students to join our teams for summer 2027. All interns will receive a meaningful project and an unparalleled experience. We’ll provide the tools and resources you need to learn. The challenging and creative work you do throughout your internship will directly impact the team you are contributing to. All internships will be conducted in-person. Hosting managers will determine when and how often interns work in the office. All interns will have the option to opt into relocation services (flights, trains, or car mileage reimbursement). Additionally, all interns will be provided with a living stipend to subsidize housing, utility, commuting, and miscellaneous costs. Program Requirements Currently enrolled in a certificate, associate's, bachelor’s or master’s degree program and graduating May 2027 – June 2028 Available to participate in a 12-week internship starting in mid-May or mid-June Currently residing in the US or open to relocating oneself to the US Exhibits learning agility; has the ability to think differently, and/or grasp and apply new skills and concepts Approaches problems in a clear, well-organized, and solutions-oriented manner Works well with others and contributes to team tasks Able to effectively communicate problems, solutions, needs, or priorities Is engaged, seeks to learn, and is able to manage time effectively A passion for significantly impacting game development Applicants must apply with a resume and portfolio/reel Internship Opportunities VFX Intern (Hearthstone) As a VFX Intern with the Hearthstone team, you will develop and implement real-time visual effects that support gameplay in the fun and whimsical style synonymous with Hearthstone. You’ll learn how to utilize the principles of motion, dynamics, follow-through, lighting, and other facets of animation to create dynamic effects that enhance the visual storytelling experience. Requirements: Skilled with variety of tools for real time VFX creation including Adobe Creative Suite, Maya, Unity and in-game FX systems Highly creative and technically minded with the ability to provide solutions to design, creative and technical issues Portfolio/reel demonstrating real-time VFX work that fits the visual style of Hearthstone/World of Warcraft Hosting Locations : Blizzard (Irvine, CA) Your Platform Best known for iconic video game universes including Warcraft®, Overwatch®, Diablo®, and StarCraft®, Blizzard Entertainment, Inc. ( www.blizzard.com ), a division of Activision Blizzard, which was acquired by Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), is a premier developer and publisher of entertainment experiences. Blizzard Entertainment has created some of the industry’s most critically acclaimed and genre-defining games over the last 30 years, with a track record that includes multiple Game of the Year awards. Blizzard Entertainment engages tens of millions of players around the world with titles available on PC via Battle.net®, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, iOS, and Android. Our World Activision Blizzard, Inc., is one of the world's largest and most successful interactive entertainment companies and is at the intersection of media, technology and entertainment. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, World of Warcraft®, Overwatch®, Diablo®, Candy Crush™ and Bubble Witch™. Our combined entertainment network delights hundreds of millions of monthly active users in 196 countries, making us the largest gaming network on the planet! Our ability to build immersive and innovative worlds is only enhanced by diverse teams working in an inclusive environment.  We aspire to have a culture where everyone can thrive in order to connect and engage the world through epic entertainment. offers.title: Senior VFX Technical Artist - Unpublished R&D Product
offers.location: Sydney, Oceania, Australia, New South Wales
offers.description: At Riot, Senior Technical Artists build the systems, tools, and workflows that help artists create high-quality content efficiently and sustainably. In this role, you’ll combine hands-on real-time VFX craft with technical problem-solving to turn creative and gameplay goals into reusable, scalable solutions that support artists, designers, and engineers. As a Senior VFX Technical Artist on an unpublished R&D product, you’ll help establish and evolve the VFX systems and content pipelines that bring the experience to life. You’ll own meaningful technical problems end to end, from prototyping Niagara-based solutions and artist-facing tools to developing Houdini workflows, documenting best practices, and improving performance and production reliability. You will report into the Technical Art Manager of the team. Responsibilities: Own and evolve scalable VFX systems, tools, libraries, and content pipelines in Unreal Engine and Niagara. Build reusable, modular, and parameterized effects and workflows that reduce one-off production, support rapid iteration, and empower artists to create varied content from a maintainable foundation. Partner with VFX Art, Design, Engineering, and Technical Art to translate creative and gameplay needs into robust technical solutions, advocating for artist workflows and clear player-facing readability. Develop artist-facing tools, scripts, and automation, including Houdini-based procedural workflows and integrations between DCC applications and real-time content pipelines. Work hands-on in Unreal Engine to prototype and validate systems using Niagara modules and Scratchpad, Blueprint, and material workflows. Profile and optimize effects for visual quality, gameplay clarity, memory, and runtime performance, helping establish practical budgets for high effect density and resource-constrained scenarios. Maintain documentation, standards, and production support practices that make VFX workflows easier to adopt, troubleshoot, and improve over time. Required Qualifications: Senior-level professional experience as a Technical Artist, VFX Technical Artist, or closely related role in games or real-time content production. Advanced hands-on Unreal Engine experience, including Niagara systems, Niagara modules and Scratchpad, Blueprint, and material authoring or Material Graphs. Strong scripting and automation skills for artist-facing tools and content workflows, with the ability to work productively in Python, Blueprint, or comparable scripting environments. Hands-on pipeline development experience, including procedural workflows, asset generation, and integration with real-time content pipelines. Proven experience designing or maintaining reusable, modular, and parameterized VFX systems, libraries, or production workflows. Strong understanding of real-time VFX readability, profiling, optimization, and performance budgeting, with the ability to balance visual quality and runtime constraints. Demonstrated ability to collaborate across Art, Design, and Engineering, communicate technical trade-offs clearly, and support artists through tool iteration and problem-solving. Desired Qualifications: Experience supporting large-scale multiplayer or live-service content pipelines, where consistency, scalability, and maintainability are central production concerns. Experience developing procedural content workflows or reusable generation systems in Houdini, Unreal, or related tools. Experience with streaming, resource, memory, or workload optimization for content-rich real-time experiences. Familiarity with shader or engine-level development, including HLSL, C++, or comparable low-level graphics and runtime technologies. A portfolio or reel that demonstrates technical breakdowns, reusable systems, artist-facing tools, pipeline improvements, and the impact of your work on content production. For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role! Our Perks: At Riot we strongly believe in work / life balance, and we encourage that with our open paid time off policy, paid parental leave (for both primary and secondary carers) and flexible work schedules to fit your lifestyle. We also believe that work should be fun, we have co-op gaming areas, a play fund so you can broaden and deepen your knowledge of players and community, and all the snacks you would ever need to power through your day (even healthy snacks!). offers.title: Senior VFX Artist - Unpublished R&D Product
offers.description: Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience. We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints. That's where you come in. As part of the Real-Time VFX team, you’ll design and help implement the sleek, dynamic and dramatic special effects that add atmosphere and depth to gameplay. With your experience, you’ll create aesthetically astounding visual effects that communicate essential game information. You’ll use your artistic and technical skills to breathe life into undead spells, channel primal emotions and capture the essence of hundreds of champions. As a Senior VFX Artist on the Unpublished R&D Product, you will help establish the project's VFX quality bar and work closely with Design, Animation, Technical Art, Engineering, Narrative, and external partners to deliver high-quality content. You will report into the Art Director of the team. Responsibilities Partner with the VFX Lead, Art Director, and cross-functional leaders to establish and continuously improve VFX visual standards, production guidelines, and quality goals. Lead early visual exploration, defining timing, color, composition, motion, layering, and readability, and translating creative direction into actionable production standards. Create high-quality in-game VFX using Unreal Engine and related real-time VFX toolchains, contributing across the full process from creative exploration and prototyping through final implementation and iteration. Solve complex artistic and technical challenges while exploring new VFX techniques, workflows, and tools that improve the team's visual quality and production efficiency. Collaborate closely with Gameplay Design, Animation, Technical Art, Engineering, Narrative, and other partner teams to clarify goals, align expectations, and ensure that the visual experience supports gameplay. Provide clear, specific, and actionable feedback to internal artists and external partners, including demonstrations, revision guidance, and paintovers when needed, ensuring that final work meets the project's visual direction and readability standards. Partner with Technical Art and Engineering to support performance, asset standards, runtime stability, and cross-scenario adaptability, and help drive timely resolution of VFX-related technical issues. Support the VFX Lead in developing team workflows, training materials, and shared knowledge to help new team members and external partners understand and meet project standards. Required Qualifications: 8+ years of professional experience in game VFX or real-time visual effects, with experience shipping or developing full game projects. Strong command of VFX and art fundamentals, including timing, rhythm, color, composition, motion, layering, material expression, and visual readability. Strong aesthetic judgment and visual communication skills, with the ability to create and iterate efficiently within an established art direction. Experience with Unreal Engine and real-time VFX production workflows; experience with Niagara or comparable tools is a plus. Ability to translate abstract creative goals into clear visual solutions, production standards, and actionable feedback. Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines, cultures, and regions. Fluency in Mandarin Chinese. Desired Qualifications: Experience establishing VFX guidelines, quality standards, or production workflows from the ground up. Experience managing external partners, mentoring partner teams, or collaborating with distributed teams. Familiarity with Houdini, Substance, Photoshop, Maya, Blender, or other relevant tools. Fluency in English. Application Materials Please provide a portfolio or demo reel highlighting real-time VFX and the specific contributions you made to each project. Whenever possible, please clarify your responsibilities, tools, and individual impact. Some candidates may be asked to complete an art test. For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

offers.title: Lead VFX Artist
offers.description: About Gameloft Here at Gameloft, we create moments of happiness for our players all over the world through exciting gaming experiences. This is our mission, and it has been the same for over 25 years. We are the proud creators of Asphalt, Dungeon Hunter, Modern Combat, and over 200 other great games. There is a game for everyone, and we are now expanding to cross-platform games on PC and consoles, with titles such as Disney Speedstorm and Disney Dreamlight Valley, to provide our players with even more amazing adventures. With more than 3,000 passionate Gamelofters across the globe, we take great pride in our differences and draw on them to create games just as diverse as we are. If you’re looking for a new challenge and want to work with a bold and talented group of people, don’t hesitate to join the game! WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON Main challenge We are looking for a Lead VFX Artist to lead the VFX discipline across our games, combining strong artistic expertise with team coordination, visual direction, and pipeline development. You will work closely with the Art Director and key stakeholders across the studio to ensure a consistent visual and technical quality across all VFX, while supporting project and studio goals. You will oversee the VFX process from initial concepts and prototyping through implementation, iteration, optimisation, and final delivery. Working with our proprietary engine and in-house tools, you will also contribute to the evolution of our VFX workflows, standards, and technology. What it means on a daily basis VFX Team Leadership: Oversee and coordinate the VFX team, establish priorities, and ensure deadlines and quality targets are met. Identify and remove systemic blockers early and proactively adjust resources and scope. Visual Direction & Quality: Work with the Art Director to ensure visual and technical unity across all VFX. Review completed work against artistic, technical, and gameplay requirements and advance VFX quality through regular reviews. Cross-Team Collaboration: Collaborate with Art Leads, Producers, Gameplay, Tech Art, Engineering, and other teams. Provide constructive feedback to internal and external partners. VFX Pipeline: Oversee the entire VFX pipeline, from initial concept and prototyping through implementation, iteration, optimisation, and final delivery. Standards & Workflows: Establish and maintain VFX standards, workflows, tools, and best practices. Ensure effects meet performance and platform requirements. Team Development: Participate in recruitment, mentor VFX artists, and foster team growth and development. What success will look like After 3 months, you will have built a strong understanding of the studio's projects, VFX workflows, team structure, and production requirements. You will have established effective working relationships with the Art Director and key stakeholders across the studio. After 6 months, you will be independently driving VFX priorities, supporting the team in delivering against project goals, and contributing to the evolution of VFX standards, workflows, and quality across the studio. Who you would be working with You will report to the Studio Art Director and work closely with VFX artists, Art Leads, Producers, Gameplay, Tech Art, Engineering, and other art and development teams. You will also collaborate with internal and external partners throughout the production process. Your recruitment journey HR Screen Call Test Second Interview Final Interview Where this role can take you This role can offer opportunities to deepen your expertise in VFX leadership, expand your responsibilities across the wider art discipline, and contribute to the development of VFX standards, workflows, and technology. You will also have access to development opportunities, mentorship, coaching, or internal mobility depending on business and individual opportunities. WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED Demonstrated advanced expertise in real-time VFX for games, supported by a strong portfolio. Strong knowledge of visual effects techniques for creating real-time VFX in a 3D game engine. Strong knowledge of industry-standard game engines such as Unity, Unreal Engine, or CryEngine. Solid understanding of game development and how VFX contribute to gameplay, visual feedback, and the overall player experience. Experience creating particle systems and VFX in 3D packages such as Maya, Houdini, or 3ds Max. Experience with VFX techniques and plugins for 3D software packages such as RayFire, Krakatoa, FumeFX, AfterBurn, or Maya Fluids. Ability to establish priorities, manage workflows, and coordinate a VFX team while maintaining quality and delivery standards. Ability to take initiative, provide creative input, and positively accept and apply feedback. Willingness to work with in-house tools and contribute to the development and improvement of proprietary game technology. Expertise in GLSL or HLSL would be beneficial. Previous experience in mobile game development would be a plus. Some experience with animation would also be a plus. Fluent professional English, written and spoken, for collaboration in an international environment. WHO YOU ARE You are a creative and experienced VFX professional who can combine artistic vision with an understanding of production and technical requirements. You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with different disciplines and stakeholders. You are comfortable giving and receiving constructive feedback and using it to improve both your own work and the team's output. You can organise priorities, identify blockers, and proactively find solutions in a production environment. You are interested in developing people, processes, and workflows alongside the quality of the VFX itself. Why Join the World of Gameloft? Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing! Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers! Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries & cultures! Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace! Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work! Benefits Permanent contract and full-time position with excellent social benefits. 25 vacation days per year. Private medical health insurance. Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card. Flexible work-from-home hybrid model. Free language courses. Your birthday off! 1 month of remote work. Merit-based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package. Career development opportunities. Excellent working conditions, with our office located in the centre of Barcelona. ...and Thursday after-work beers! We can’t wait to find our next great talent! Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us! Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted and your CV will be saved in our files for a period of 6 months. Want to know more? Please visit our Website: www.gameloft.com If the offer interests you, Join the Game!

offers.title: Senior VFX Artist [Tom Clancy's The Division 3]
offers.description: Company Description Massive Entertainment is a world-renowned AAA game development studio with offices in Malmö and Stockholm, and a proud part of the Ubisoft family. Our diverse and talented team of around 600 professionals hails from more than 50 countries, all driven by a shared passion for crafting memorable gaming experiences. At Massive, we are committed to pushing the boundaries of creativity and technology, currently leading projects such as Tom Clancy’s The Division 3, Tom Clancy’s The Division 2 and Tom Clancy’s The Division 2: Survivors. We're also at the forefront of tech innovation, developing our proprietary Snowdrop engine, which powers many of Ubisoft’s flagship titles, and contributing to Ubisoft Connect, Ubisoft's digital ecosystem and distribution platform. Join us, and you'll have the opportunity to do what you love while shaping the future of interactive entertainment. Job Description In 2023, it was announced that Massive Entertainment is leading the development of Tom Clancy's The Division 3. While we cannot unveil any details about the third entry in the series at this time, we are actively recruiting for the project. We are looking for a Senior VFX Artist with a strong technical skill-set and drive, to join our team. You'll be responsible for creating astonishing visual effects aligned with the games artistic vision and utilizing the technical possibilities of our Snowdrop engine. You'll work closely with our Technical Art team, and other interdisciplinary peers. What you'll do Producing realistic looking visual effects Planning, estimating and prioritizing your tasks Optimizing workflows and maintaining a balance between quality and performance Building relationships with Artists, Designers, Technical Artists and Programmers to facilitate effective collaboration during the creation of our game assets Establishing and share best practices relating to VFX Providing tutorials, documentation and guides of project tools and pipelines. Contributing and participate in a culture of open and honest feedback. As a Senior you'll also be mentoring, coaching and sharing feedback with your peers Qualifications What you'll Bring Professional experience with VFX, including at least one AAA game development cycle. Strong working knowledge in VFX tools including Maya, as well as an understanding of the technical constraints within a game engine. A portfolio/showreel detailing your experience with key real-time VFX elements You are comfortable working autonomously and can present your ideas in a clear way. You thrive when improving current processes with your technical knowledge and you are motivated to understand how things work. You are comfortable collaborating within a multidisciplinary team where you can each utilize your niche expertise to achieve a higher quality together. Additional Information Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown! You can also find a summary of the Massive Job Perks here. Questions? We're more than happy to answer them! Please contact Paula Roese Mesquita , Talent Acquisition Partner for this position All your application information will be kept confidential according to EEO & GDPR guidelines. Contract: PermanentWork flexibility: Office-based

offers.title: Artiste de VFX Sénior.e
offers.description: We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime. Nous prenons le jeu au sérieux. Nous recherchons des aventurières et aventuriers à l’esprit curieux, prêts à trouver leurs compagnons de route et animés par l’imagination et la détermination nécessaires pour créer ce qui n’a encore jamais été imaginé. Chez Wizards of the Coast, nous misons sur le pouvoir de l’imagination et des liens humains pour créer des expériences inoubliables. Nous créons des divertissements qui stimulent la créativité, éveillent les passions, tissent des amitiés et rassemblent des communautés partout dans le monde. Dans tout ce que nous entreprenons, notre mission est d’inspirer une passion pour les jeux qui dure toute une vie. Que ce soit par la profondeur stratégique de Magic: The Gathering®, la richesse narrative de Dungeons & Dragons® ou nos studios de jeux vidéo AAA, nous bâtissons des mondes qui rassemblent les gens, stimulent la créativité et nourrissent le goût de l’aventure. Alors que nous poursuivons notre croissance et explorons de nouveaux horizons, nous cherchons des personnes passionnées, curieuses et innovantes pour se joindre à l’aventure. Skeleton Key est un studio de développement de jeux vidéo et une division de Wizards of the Coast. Nous sommes une équipe animée par la conviction qu’en donnant à nos équipes les moyens d’agir ainsi que le temps, les outils et le soutien nécessaires, nous pouvons cultiver un environnement créatif où chaque personne peut donner le meilleur d’elle-même. Le siège social de Skeleton Key est situé à Austin, au Texas, et nous mettons sur pied une nouvelle équipe en pleine croissance à Montréal, au Québec. Nous recherchons un·e artiste VFX sénior de talent, qui se passionne pour la création d’une grande variété d’effets en temps réel pour les environnements, les personnages et les éléments du jeu, afin de se joindre à l’équipe de Montréal et de contribuer à donner vie à notre premier jeu AAA. Ce que tu feras Améliorer la qualité visuelle du jeu en créant des effets visuels en temps réel de grande qualité. Collaborer avec les équipes d’art, d’éclairage, de conception, de son, d’animation et de production pour donner vie aux niveaux et aux fonctionnalités du jeu. Contribuer à l’amélioration des pipelines techniques ainsi que des techniques et des outils de création d’effets visuels. Participer aux activités de recherche et développement. Accompagner les artistes en effets visuels débutant·e·s et leur offrir du mentorat. Ce que tu apporteras De l’expérience avec Unreal Engine. Une expérience démontrée dans la création d’effets visuels de grande qualité qui s’intègrent harmonieusement aux jeux. Une connaissance des systèmes Niagara, de la création de matériaux, de textures et de Blueprints, de Chaos Destruction ainsi que d’autres systèmes d’effets visuels en temps réel. Des compétences à la fois techniques et créatives, soutenues par une vision artistique. Une solide compréhension des systèmes de particules et de leur dynamique. Une connaissance d’outils complémentaires comme EmberGen, LiquiGen, Houdini, Maya, 3ds Max, Blender, Photoshop et After Effects. De l’expérience pour donner et recevoir de la rétroaction. De l’expérience dans la gestion de plusieurs tâches à la fois et une facilité à t’adapter au changement. Une passion pour la création de jeux vidéo et le plaisir d’y jouer. De l’enthousiasme, une attitude positive et un esprit d’équipe, ainsi qu’une capacité à communiquer et à collaborer avec l’ensemble des services et des équipes.
