Build artist-facing Unity tools, validators, custom inspectors, asset processors, and batch workflows. Optimize effects for mobile GPUs, memory, overdraw, shader complexity, and runtime performance. Collaborate with VFX Artists, Technical Artists, Gameplay Engineers, and Rendering Engineers. Prototype new technical approaches and take successful solutions through to production. Establish reusable templates, documentation, and technical standards for the VFX team. Requirements Strong HLSL shader programming experience. Fluency with node-based tools such as Shader Graph, Amplify, or similar. Strong understanding of real-time rendering including blending, transparency, sorting, depth, instancing, and scriptable or custom render pipelines. Experience shipping particle-based effects in Unity using Shuriken or equivalent systems. Experience with mesh particles, trails, flipbooks, and shader-driven effects. Experience designing scalable effect runtimes for high-frequency effects, including pooling, batching, prioritization, or budget management. Strong C# gameplay or engine programming experience. Experience with ECS/DOTS, Jobs, Burst, or equivalent performance-focused architecture is strongly preferred. Strong understanding of mobile GPU optimization including overdraw, half precision, texture budgets, memory, and shader variants. Unity editor tooling experience including custom inspectors, drawers, asset processors, or batch tools. Vertex animation techniques. SDFs, procedural noise, and procedural rendering. Experience with procedural or voxel geometry, dynamic meshes, hull generation, or custom lighting systems. Networked gameplay effects including predicted versus confirmed events. Experience with multiplayer or large-scale gameplay systems. Strong artistic eye and ability to participate in VFX look development. Experience building effects for mobile or other performance-constrained platforms. Direct collaboration with experienced VFX Artists, Technical Artists, Rendering Engineers, and Gameplay Engineers. The opportunity to solve challenging rendering and performance problems. A role where engineering directly enables creative ambition. A highly collaborative international team. Fully remote work. Flexible contract options depending on location. Competitive compensation based on experience and contract structure. Annual Beffio team retreats. The possibility of long-term collaboration as the project grows.

You will work closely with Product Leads, Delivery Leads, Stakeholders, and the Associate Art Director to stay aligned on vision and priorities. Run and manage healthy and productive craft review sessions. Work closely with the others VFX Leads on Teamfight Tactics Cosmetic to together cultivate a great cohesive culture and ensure a consistent quality and style. Responsibilities: Oversee and be accountable for the quality of the work the team delivers and set the bar for excellence. Provide craft direction for your team. offers.title: Sr. VFX Artist
offers.description: Lakshya, a Keywords Studios company, in India is headquartered in Gurgaon and has a team of over 700 employees spread across studio facilities in Gurgaon, Pune and Seattle, and sales offices in San Diego and Tokyo. Setup in 2004, Lakshya has, over the last 20 years, created a reputation in the game development industry for being a highly talented and dependable game art studio. During this time, Lakshya has created art for over a hundred game titles, including hugely successful global hits such as Bloodborne, Dark Souls II, Just Cause 3, WWE 2K16, Uncharted 2, Farmville and Cityville. Lakshya’s senior team, which comprises of top-notch International and Indian talent, has a huge amount of experience of creating art for different game platforms and genres. Lakshya blends artistic creativity with strong process orientation in order to deliver best in class services. Lakshya works closely with NASSCOM to help in the growth of the game development eco-system in India. For more info, please refer to https://lakshyadigital.com/ About the Role: We are seeking a Senior VFX Artist to help lead the creation of high-impact real-time effects. In this role, you will create and implement VFX that bring Legends, weapons, and seasonal moments to life — reporting to the Lead VFX Artist and collaborating closely with Art, Design, Animation, and Engineering to raise the visual quality bar across the game. We are looking for someone with a passion for visceral, intense combat and a deep understanding of how VFX can drive player intensity, readability, and emotional impact in a fight. 5+ years of professional experience as a real-time VFX artist in the games or film industry. Strong portfolio of shipped in-game real-time VFX work; portfolio examples that showcase bombastic, gritty combat and VFX-driven player intensity are a strong plus. Proficiency with relevant DCC tools such as Maya, Houdini, Photoshop, or Substance Designer, and experience implementing your own work within a game engine or proprietary toolset. Experience mentoring, reviewing work, or helping guide other artists, with strong communication and collaboration skills across disciplines. Passion for making and playing games. Experience creating VFX for visceral, intense combat games is a plus. Experience with first-person games, sci-fi art direction, or live-service seasonal content is a plus. Shipped AAA game credit is a plus. Responsibilities: Create and implement high-quality real-time VFX for abilities, weapons, seasonal content, and gameplay moments — with a focus on delivering effects that feel visceral, impactful, and true to the intensity of combat. Help define and maintain the visual quality bar for VFX across seasonal updates, weapon releases, character abilities, and gameplay moments. VFX problem-solving for complex content, including visual polish, performance constraints, and technical issues across the content pipeline. Collaborate closely with Art, Design, Animation, and Engineering to develop effects that support gameplay, improve clarity, and strengthen the visual identity of Apex Legends. Helping raise the quality and consistency of the team’s work. Contribute to visual direction and help evolve real-time VFX language, supporting production planning to ensure work is scoped and delivered effectively. We offer the opportunity to work on some of the best-known game titles in the world. We offer competitive salaries and annual performance-based bonuses. We offer generous paid time off. You get 26 Annual leaves and additional paid time off at the year-end (from 25th December to 1st January). We cover Term Insurance and Personal accidental insurance for you. Benefit from our free Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental and emotional wellbeing. You can also avail our Special Education Assistance Scheme to further develop your career. … And a lot more! offers.title: Activision 2027 Summer Internships - VFX
offers.location: Carlsbad, North America, USA, California, Los Angeles
offers.description: Job Title: Activision 2027 Summer Internships - VFX Requisition ID: R028074 Job Description: Activision is looking for talented and innovative students to join our teams for summer 2027. All interns will receive a meaningful project and an unparalleled experience. We’ll provide the tools and resources you need to learn. The challenging and creative work you do throughout your internship will directly impact the team you are contributing to. All internships will be conducted in-person. Hosting managers will determine when and how often interns work in the office. All interns will have the option to opt into relocation services (flights, trains, or car mileage reimbursement). Additionally, all interns will be provided with a living stipend to subsidize housing, utility, commuting, and miscellaneous costs. Program Requirements Currently enrolled in a certificate, associate’s, bachelor’s, or master’s degree program and graduating May 2027 - June 2028 Available to participate in a 12-week internship starting in mid-May or mid-June Currently residing in the US or open to relocating oneself to the US Exhibits learning agility; has the ability to think differently, and/or grasp and apply new skills and concepts Approaches problems in a clear, well-organized, and solutions-oriented manner Works well with others and contributes to team tasks Able to effectively communicate problems, solutions, needs, or priorities Is engaged, seeks to learn, and is able to manage time effectively A passion for significantly impacting game development Applicants must apply with a resume and portfolio/reel to be considered Internship Opportunities VFX Intern: Join our world-class team bringing the iconic visuals of Call of Duty to life. As a VFX Intern, you’ll contribute to real-time effects that heighten gameplay—from explosive battlefield moments to immersive environmental details. You’ll collaborate with experienced artists and engineers to design dynamic, cinematic, and optimized visual effects using tools and in-game FX systems. This internship offers hands-on experience with AAA production pipelines, scripting multi-state FX objects, and balancing artistry with performance across next-gen platforms. You’ll gain a deep understanding of how visual effects shape player immersion and define the Call of Duty experience. Requirements: Experience creating real-time VFX simulations using Maya, 3ds Max, or in-game FX editors. Familiarity with Unreal, Unity, or proprietary game engines. Strong understanding of particle systems, shaders, dynamics, and 3D fundamentals. Experience with Houdini or Photoshop are a plus. A portfolio/reel that showcases real-time, photoreal visual effects is required Hosting Locations : High Moon Studios (Carlsbad, CA) & Treyarch (Playa Vista, CA) Our World At Activision, we strive to create the most iconic brands in gaming and entertainment. We’re driven by our mission to deliver unrivaled gaming experiences for the world to enjoy, together. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, Crash Bandicoot™, Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™, and Guitar Hero®. As a leading worldwide developer, publisher and distributor of interactive entertainment and products, our “press start” is simple: delight hundreds of millions of players around the world with innovative, fun, thrilling, and engaging entertainment experiences. We’re not just looking back at our decades-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization. We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. And our future opportunities have never been greater — this could be your opportunity to level up. Ready to Activate Your Future? The video game industry and therefore our business is fast-paced and will continue to evolve. As such, the duties and responsibilities of this role may be changed as directed by the Company at any time to promote and support our business and relationships with industry partners. We love hearing from anyone who is enthusiastic about changing the games industry. Not sure you meet all qualifications? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other under-represented groups tend to not apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they often do! We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and strongly encourage you to apply. We are committed to working with and providing reasonable assistance to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are a disabled individual requiring an accommodation to apply for an open position, please email your request to accommodationrequests@activisionblizzard.com . General employment questions cannot be accepted or processed here. Thank you for your interest. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, among other characteristics. Rewards We provide a suite of benefits that promote physical, emotional and financial well-being for ‘Every World’ - we’ve got our employees covered!  Subject to eligibility requirements, the Company offers comprehensive benefits including: Medical, dental, vision, health savings account or health reimbursement account, healthcare spending accounts, dependent care spending accounts, life and AD&D insurance, disability insurance; 401(k) with Company match, tuition reimbursement, charitable donation matching; Paid holidays and vacation, paid sick time, floating holidays, compassion and bereavement leaves, parental leave; Mental health & wellbeing programs, fitness programs, free and discounted games, and a variety of other voluntary benefit programs like supplemental life & disability, legal service, ID protection, rental insurance, and others; If the Company requires that you move geographic locations for the job, then you may also be eligible for relocation assistance. Eligibility to participate in these benefits may vary for part time and temporary full-time employees and interns with the Company.  You can learn more by visiting https://www.benefitsforeveryworld.com/ . In the U.S., the standard base pay range for this role is $20.00 - $50.00 Hourly. These values reflect the expected base pay range of new hires across all U.S. locations. Ultimately, your specific range and offer will be based on several factors, including relevant experience, performance, and work location. Your Talent Professional can share this role’s range details for your local geography during the hiring process. In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role may be eligible for incentive compensation. Incentive compensation is not guaranteed.   While we strive to provide competitive offers to successful candidates, new hire compensation is negotiable.

offers.title: VFX Artist (Assassin's Creed Invictus)
offers.description: Company Description Job Description As a VFX Artist at Ubisoft Montréal , you will create impactful visual moments that enrich gameplay and elevate the player experience. You will help bring immersive worlds to life through environmental effects such as smoke, fire, explosions, snow, water, and other real-time visual effects . In this role, you will combine creativity and technical expertise to design, integrate, and optimize high-quality visual effects directly in the game engine . You will collaborate with multiple teams to deliver a cohesive, performant, and visually engaging experience. What you’ll do Collaborate with creative direction to understand the project vision and define visual effects priorities Create environmental effects using particle systems and original textures Partner with programming teams to assess needs and support tool development Design visual effects that respect technical constraints while maintaining strong artistic impact Integrate visual effects into the game engine and ensure real-time performance Refine and optimize effects based on playtest results Troubleshoot technical issues related to visual effects when needed Adjust effects based on feedback from collaborating teams Consider community feedback post-launch when relevant Qualifications What you bring to the team Demonstrate skills in creating real-time visual effects for games or interactive media Understand 3D production pipelines including modeling, texturing, lighting, or image processing Know 2D art tools , compositing software , 3D software , and game engines Understand art fundamentals such as lighting, composition, proportion, and color theory Apply vector mathematics to visual effects work Receive feedback and adapt your work accordingly Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams Communicate clearly and maintain strong attention to detail Use procedural tools or shader workflows , considered an asset What to send our way Your CV highlighting relevant skills and experiences A portfolio showcasing your strongest visual effects along with insight into your creative process Contract: PermanentWork flexibility: Office-based

offers.title: Senior VFX Artist - New Mobile Game
offers.description:
We are looking for a Senior VFX Artist to join our in-house art team working on a new mobile game . Bring your passion for gaming, VFX, and Tech Art. Learn continuously by interacting with our experienced team of Artists and Game Development specialists. We are enthusiastic about what we do, and we have fun doing it! Your mission Create high-quality real-time VFX for a 3D mobile game, including combat effects, abilities, impacts, environmental effects, transitions, UI effects, and reward moments. Build and improve art pipelines, tools, exporters, validation systems, and automation workflows. Develop , optimize, and maintain shaders and materials suitable for mobile performance constraints. Collaborate with engineers and artists on VFX pipelines, tools, performance profiling, and implementation workflows. Your skill set Expertise. You can showcase your professional experience (4+ years) based on an impressive portfolio. Knowledge . You have a solid understanding of graphics math and a willingness to keep learning and improving in this area. Coding . You are proficient in coding with C#, Python, HLSL, and CG Shader language or similar languages. 3D. You are experienced in modeling, skinning, and animation. Tools. You are skilled in using Houdini, Blender Geometry Nodes, or other comparable software. AI. You are willing to embrace new technologies and keen on AI-assisted production. Tech. You are proficient in using Unity3D. You understand technical constraints and are able to integrate your assets into the engine yourself. Team play. You are a proactive communicator, enjoy sharing knowledge, and are confidently interacting with an international/intercultural team of experts. Qualification. You have completed a university degree or comparable training in the field of graphics. English as company language. You feel comfortable in using your excellent English skills in both spoken and written form daily. Your power-ups Career opportunities. Level up with excellent training and development opportunities, such as online trainings, InnoVersity and conferences. Outstanding benefits. Get 28 vacation days, a sabbatical, mobile device, contribution to your public transport ticket, and more. Flexible working hours. We offer trust-based working hours as well as active breaks - play table tennis with your team, work out in our gym or go to our rooftop terrace to get some fresh air. Hybrid Working Model. We offer our colleagues the flexibility to choose between working from home and our modern offices in central Hamburg. With regular times planned together at the office during our Office Days , we keep up our unique InnoGames spirit! Compensation & Fair Play . We have career models as well as market-competitive salary grids in place that ensure that we treat our employees fairly. For this position the regular level salary starts at € 50,000 and the senior level salary starts at € 65,000. The salary ranges for other seniority levels differ. Your seniority level (junior, regular, senior) will be evaluated during the interview process. Team of specialists. Be part of a stable, growing, and award-winning global company. Meet your future colleagues in Creative & Product Management . Team events. What you bring to the table The video game industry and therefore our business is fast-paced and will continue to evolve. Lead a team to craft and implement compelling particle effects and systems that communicate essential game information. Drive visual and technical quality to deliver cutting-edge, AAA-worthy VFX. Prototype VFX systems, particle materials, and improve workflows to achieve the desired tone and gameplay needs. Spearhead VFX R&D efforts, partnering with experts within and across disciplines to champion best practices and visual targets. Partner with artists, designers, and programmers to be a trusted champion of performance, efficiency, and quality. Inspire and mentor others as a role model of initiative, accountability, and attitude. Foster a thriving team with open communication, constructive feedback, and development opportunities. Hold a high bar for quality, execution, and accountability while fostering artist growth. Collaborate with Production to plan team goals, forecast milestone deliveries, and identify resource needs. Clearly communicate risks, mitigations, and updates while maintaining effective working relationships across the studio. Player Profile 8+ total years of Visual Effects experience, with 2+ years in a Lead role, in real-time game development or equivalent experience in film/television. Lead by example with a passionate and egoless attitude that welcomes feedback and enjoys a collaborative, iterative, fast-moving and adaptive workflow. Ability to quickly learn new software and adapt to proprietary tools. Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills. Expert experience with game development engines and particle effects tools (Unreal, Unity, or equivalent proprietary engines). Strong experience with relevant 2D and 3D software (Photoshop, After Effects, Maya, Max, Houdini, Substance Designer, EmberGen, or similar tools). Strong understanding and application of rigid body and fluid simulations, post-processing, and shader development for visual effects creation. Strong understanding of modern game VFX workflows and emerging industry trends. An inspiring reel demonstrating strong, realistic visual effects, modern development workflows, and creative solutions to development challenges. Extra Points Experience working with the Call of Duty tools or other proprietary engines. Experience in a secondary area such as modeling, animation, or lighting. Experience with basic scripting. Experience with procedural workflows and tools. Understanding of real-time physics systems. Familiarity with performance optimization for console and PC. Passion for the Call of Duty franchise. Strong traditional art foundation. Your Platform Founded in 1990 by brothers Brian and Steve Raffel in Middleton, Wisconsin, Raven Software began as a small studio focused on crafting fantasy and role-playing games. Since then, our award-winning portfolio has grown to include beloved titles such as Hexen, Star Wars Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast, Marvel: Ultimate Alliance, and - for the past 15 years - major contributions to the critically acclaimed Call of Duty® franchise. As the lead developers behind Call of Duty: Warzone and the force behind the campaigns of the Black Ops series, most recently Black Ops 6, we have established ourselves as a key player in shaping the FPS genre and pushing the boundaries of what games can achieve. Our motto, “Our Work Speaks For Us,” symbolizes the dedication and passion that drives everything we do. We’ve built a team rooted in respect, collaboration, and a shared focus on what’s best for the game. We prioritize ambition balanced with care, direct communication, and a culture free of egos. By fostering innovation and owning our mistakes, we continually push boundaries to create unforgettable games for our players. As a studio located in Middleton - a suburb of Madison consistently ranked among the best places to live - we offer a thriving, supportive environment paired with exceptional quality of life. As we grow and enter the next chapter of our journey, we’re looking for talented individuals eager to pave new ground in our industry. If you’re ready to work with a world-class team, we’d love to hear from you. offers.title: Senior VFX Artist
offers.description: Company Description To create revolutionary, story-driven RPGs which go straight to the hearts of gamers — this is our mission. Want to dive deeper into our company’s culture? Explore our social media and check out our YouTube channel and Beyond the Game Blog where we share behind-the-scenes insights and stories direct from our team members! Job Description We’re looking for a Senior VFX Artist to join the CD PROJEKT RED team dedicated to crafting the studio’s first-ever original IP and video game, codenamed Project Hadar. We believe the universe we are creating is one bursting with limitless potential, and we want you to help us broaden and utilize it, making sure it not only matches gamers’ high expectations set by past CD PROJEKT RED titles but exceeds them. As a Senior VFX Artist, you will play an important role in defining and delivering high-quality visual effects for Project Hadar. Working closely with artists, designers, programmers, and other disciplines, you will create, prototype, and optimize real-time VFX while contributing to workflows, sharing your expertise, and helping push the visual quality of the project. If you enjoy solving technical and artistic challenges, taking ownership of your work, and exploring new possibilities in real-time VFX, we'd love to hear from you. (This position requires working in our Warsaw Hub. Hybrid working mode available.) Daily Responsibilities Create, prototype, implement, and optimize high-quality visual effects in Unreal Engine 5. Develop particle systems and real-time VFX that support gameplay, characters, cinematics, and environments. Collaborate with artists, designers, programmers, and other disciplines to deliver cohesive player experiences. Contribute to the development and improvement of VFX workflows and pipelines. Research, prototype, and explore new techniques and technologies to enhance visual quality and production efficiency. Ensure VFX content meets quality, performance, and memory budgets. Debug, profile, and optimize visual effects throughout development. Share knowledge, provide technical guidance, and support the growth of fellow team members. Qualifications Demonstrated professional experience creating real-time visual effects for games. Strong artistic sensibility, with a sharp eye for detail, composition, and motion. Strong knowledge of Unreal Engine 5. Expertise in real-time simulations and optimization. Advanced skills with VFX tools and pipelines, including Niagara. Understanding of rendering techniques, shaders, lighting, and real-time graphics. Strong understanding of performance optimization for real-time VFX. Commitment to taking ownership, sharing knowledge, and driving work independently. Curiosity and willingness to learn, experiment, and continuously improve. Clear and empathetic communication skills. Fluent English, written and spoken. Nice to Have Experience with 3D software such as Houdini, Maya, or Blender is a plus. Experience with Blueprint scripting in Unreal Engine. Please include a portfolio with your application. Applications without a portfolio cannot be considered. Additional Information Working mode In-office in a hybrid or full-time capacity in Warsaw, Poland. Relocation is required. Relocation Support Relocation package — flight ticket, company apartment for your first month, relocating your pet and family, shipping your belongings. It’s all covered. Authoring believable, striking and artistic benchmark visual effects with a realistic style as defined through Art Direction Accentuating gameplay features as consequences of player actions, such as weapon effects, hit reactions, magic spells, etc. with well executed timing to give satisfying feedback for players. Contribute to storytelling through the visual style of VFX and their connection with the world building. Collaborate with the broader VFX and Tech Art teams, suggesting technology improvements and/or increased efficiency to workflows and pipelines Making quick prototypes and placeholder test effects as conversation starters. Giving constructive feedback on VFX assets with internal team and/or external partners. Optimizing visual effect assets, staying within approved budgets, considering technical limitations of different development platforms. Organizing asset libraries and textures to repurpose across multiple VFX assets and to improve performance. You’re awesome because you have… Proven experience (8+ years) in realtime VFX. Proficiency in a game engine’s special effect system (Unreal, Crytek, Unity, etc.) Deep knowledge of authoring simulations like destruction, fire, smoke and fog through simulation software such as Houdini, Thinking Particles, Fume Fx or similar. Excellent understanding of authoring VFX for physically based rendering and lighting. An impressive portfolio of realistic visual effects showcasing artistry and attention to detail. An ability to easily adapt to in-house tools and a constantly evolving environment and technology stack. Knowledge of scripting through code and/or node-based systems. Experience of standard art software and 3D packages like Photoshop, Substance Designer, Maya. Bonus points for… Experience with hooking up VFX logic in code and/or visual scripting. Understanding of and experience with authoring material and special shaders Experience with procedural workflows and techniques. Knowledge of graphics programming and shading code or graphs. offers.title: Technical Artist
offers.location: San Francisco, North America, USA, California
offers.description: Join the team bringing autonomy to the built world At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and onto real job sites. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. We retrofit the heavy equipment contractors already own, starting with excavators, so experienced crews can safely take on more projects and deliver more of the critical infrastructure our society needs. In August 2026, Bedrock-equipped excavators began doing fully autonomous, paid work on live commercial job sites. We've more than doubled our customer base since 2025, and our machines now work with contractors across the South, Midwest, and Mid-Atlantic In October 2026, we raised a $600M Series C co-led by CapitalG and Emergence Capital, bringing our total funding to nearly $1B. We're using it to put more autonomous machines to work, build the field and operations teams behind every deployment, and expand into new machine types and job-site tasks. This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us. About the Role We’re looking for an exceptional Technical Artist to join our team building and scaling our robotics simulation environment. Simulation is a critical foundation for autonomy at Bedrock—it allows us to validate end-to-end systems, evaluate complex and unsafe scenarios, and run testing at massive scale. Our autonomy stack is deeply machine-learning–driven, and closing the sim-to-real gap is a core focus of this role. The simulator must accurately represent a living, breathing construction site - real-world lighting, 3D content, and terrain deformation for digging and earthmoving - while remaining efficient enough to support thousands of runs. High-quality simulation directly accelerates robotics development, making this work central to our success. What You’ll Do Own the 3D content generation and curation pipeline for an autonomous construction simulator Develop simulation systems that support ML-based autonomy, evaluation, and safety validation Improve realism and performance to better reflect real-world behavior Help guide our strategy in procedural scene generation and rendering techniques Who You Are Simulation spans many disciplines, and we don’t expect one person to do everything. Strong candidates typically bring: A passion for large-scale, realistic simulation systems Experience with advanced 3D simulation software A hands-on mindset and enthusiasm for building core simulation content Qualifications Required Games or simulation background with minimum 4yrs working in real time 3D Strong foundation in technical art: 3D modeling, texturing, rigging, animation, PBR materials, lighting, performance optimization Hands-on experience with Unreal Engine, minimum 2yrs Preferred Robotics simulation experience Experience with Isaac Sim or Omniverse Experience with neural rendering techniques (Gaussian splats, NeRFs) Bedrock Robotics is an Equal Opportunity Employer We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic. Reasonable Accommodations We want our hiring process to be accessible to everyone. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please let your recruiter know so we can support you.

Investigate and resolve complex technical issues across assets, shaders, materials, animation, prefabs, and runtime content. offers.title: Technical Artist (Project Based)
offers.description: About us: At Amber, we’re always on the hunt for the most talented individuals in the industry to join our team. We’re dedicated to delivering top-notch service to our customers and know that our employees are key to making that happen. We offer attractive compensation packages and plenty of chances to grow with us, and we’re always on the lookout for ways to do things better. Our team works together towards common goals and we value each member’s contributions to our mission of continuous improvement and innovation. About the role: We are seeking an Experienced Technical Artist to serve as the vital bridge between our art and engineering teams. Your goal is to empower our artists with robust tools and shaders while ensuring the game runs flawlessly across all platforms, from high-end consoles to mobile devices. The Quest: IP-Driven Visual Systems: Develop custom shaders and materials that capture the unique “hand-drawn” or “stylized” look of TV shows while remaining performant. Pipeline & Tooling: Build and maintain efficient asset pipelines (Maya/Blender to Unreal) to streamline the import and validation of characters and environments. Performance Optimization: Establish and enforce strict performance budgets (polycounts, draw calls, texture memory) to ensure a stable high FPS in multiplayer local or online sessions. Rigging & Technical Animation: Oversee complex character rigging and retargeting systems to allow for the expressive, comedic animations typical of the show’s characters. VFX & Lighting: Create performant, stylized visual effects (Niagara/Shuriken) and lighting setups that enhance the “game show” or “family home” atmosphere without cluttering the screen. Documentation & Training: Create clear technical guides and “Source of Truth” documentation to help non-technical artists navigate new tools and workflows. The Skills Experience: 5+ years as a Technical Artist in game dev, with at least one shipped title in the casual or party game genre. Engine Mastery: Expert-level knowledge of Unreal Engine, including proficiency in HLSL/GLSL for shader development. Scripting Skills: Strong proficiency in Python, C#, or C++ for creating automated tools and editor extensions. Optimization Expert: Proven ability to use profiling tools (RenderDoc, Pix, or built-in engine profilers) to diagnose and fix GPU/CPU bottlenecks. Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex technical constraints into actionable creative feedback for the art team. Experience working in co-development or outsourcing is a plus Nice-to-Haves Licensed IP Experience: Previous work on games inspired by TV, film, or popular animated series. VFX Background: Strong eye for stylized particles and 2D-inspired motion graphics. Platform Versatility: Experience optimizing Nintendo Switch or mobile hardware limitations. The Reward Competitive project-based compensation Opportunity to work on exciting and diverse projects Clear communication and support throughout the project duration. Flexibility in project timelines and deadlines. Potential for long-term collaboration on future projects. Transparent and fair evaluation of your work.

We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices. Driven by a shared love for games, the team explores how new and emerging technology can elevate our craft — building visually forward-looking IP and raising the bar on art quality across Lightspeed's games. You will own shaders, rendering systems, and environment tooling; translating visual ambition into something that holds a real frame budget. This is a graphics-technical role rather than a generalist art-pipeline or art-authoring role. It sits with the art team but works at the level of the renderer. Author and maintain the project's shader and material systems in UE5 and set the technical standards that environment and art teams build against. Extend and improve the existing art pipeline in collaboration with engineering and production; this role supports pipeline work, not a greenfield pipeline build. Prototype graphics features and diagnose rendering, shader, and in-engine issues alongside art, engineering, and production teams. Profile and optimize GPU and CPU frame time, memory, and visual-quality trade-offs, and make the case with measured data. Document technical decisions and share knowledge so the solutions you build stay maintainable by the wider team. Who We Look For Hands-on Unreal Engine 5 experience is essential. Deep, engineer-level understanding of UE5 rendering systems: Lumen, Nanite, Virtual Shadow Maps, and MegaLights: how they work, what they cost, and where they break down. Strong graphics fundamentals: real-time rendering pipelines, physically based rendering (PBR), lighting and shadowing models, GPU performance characteristics, and the linear algebra and calculus that underpin 3D graphics. Ability to author and debug shaders (HLSL/GLSL or equivalent) and reason about instruction cost, overdraw, and shader budgets. Working literacy in material, lighting, and environment authoring, enough to judge visual quality and collaborate with artists while operating primarily on the technical side. Experience collaborating inside an established content pipeline: asset import, validation, version control, and performance budgets. Clear written and verbal communication, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently across art, engineering, and production. You’ll use your technical and creative skills to solve a wide range of challenges, including implementing innovative artist tooling and workflows, ensuring optimal performance on a wide range of console and PC hardware, and delivering hands-on content to support the creation of our game. You’ll help us… Support and improve content creation workflows for the art team, including performance profiling, rendering, world creation, VFX, and UI systems. Collaborate with Artists and Engineers to deliver innovative solutions that will help artists develop epic content, while keeping an eye on performance constraints. Maintain tools, workflows, and documentation that support the technical aspects of asset production. Inspire and mentor fellow tech artists as a role model for initiative, accountability, communication, and collaboration. You’ll be successful if you have… Extensive experience in the games industry in a technical art role, including at least one shipped title in a senior capacity. In-depth understanding of game engines, pipelines, and processes. Understanding of at least one scripting or programming language, such as Python, JavaScript, C#, C++, MAXScript, or MEL. In-depth knowledge of memory and performance impact from a content creation perspective. Experience writing and/or debugging shaders. Understanding of Physically Based Rendering concepts. Ability to solve problems creatively, with a positive and respectful team-first attitude. Strong organization skills and the ability to meet agreed timelines. Bonus points if you… Demonstrated strong artistic skills and attention to detail. Led a large feature or project and mentored other team members. Not sure you meet all the qualifications? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other under-represented groups tend to not apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they often do! At Activision, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and strongly encourage you to apply. This role can be based in our Malmo or Warsaw office and follows an onsite work schedule of four days per week. Work arrangements may change at the company's discretion to meet business needs. Our World At Activision, we strive to create the most iconic brands in gaming and entertainment. We’re driven by our mission to deliver unrivaled gaming experiences for the world to enjoy, together. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, Crash Bandicoot™, Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™, and Guitar Hero®. As a leading worldwide developer, publisher and distributor of interactive entertainment and products, our “press start” is simple: delight hundreds of millions of players around the world with innovative, fun, thrilling, and engaging entertainment experiences. We’re not just looking back at our decades-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization. We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. And our future opportunities have never been greater — this could be your opportunity to level up. Ready to Activate Your Future? #elsewhere

offers.title: Senior Technical Artist (Graphics)
offers.location: Burnaby, North America, Canada, British Columbia
offers.description: Who is SkyBox Labs? Recognized as one of BC's Top Employers (2025) , SkyBox Labs is a game development studio that works on some of the world’s most iconic games. The studio is currently working on projects in the Minecraft universe, supporting the dev team at Bungie on Destiny 2, supporting development of Fallout 76, in addition to work on unannounced IP. Since our inception in 2011, SkyBox Labs has evolved from a small team of eight individuals to a fully established team of Engineers, Artists, Animators, Designers, Producers, and more.Come join our hybrid team in our Burnaby, BC studio today! PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only able to hire candidates who are legally eligible to work in Canada and reside within Canada. Interested? Let’s talk about what we’re hiring for: SkyBox Labs is looking for a graphics-focused Senior Technical Artist to join our team on an ambitious AAA co-development project set within a highly anticipated universe. Working closely with our partner studio, you’ll help develop shaders and materials, optimize rendering performance, and build tools and workflows in Unreal Engine 5. You’ll use your expertise in real-time rendering and GPU profiling to achieve high visual quality while meeting performance targets. We’re looking for an experienced, proactive technical artist who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, working independently, and collaborating across art and engineering teams to find practical solutions. This is a hybrid role based at our Burnaby, BC studio, with three days per week in the office. A snapshot of your role: Shaders & Materials: Develop and optimize master materials, custom shaders, and PBR material libraries to support visual quality and performance. Rendering Performance: Profile GPU performance, identify rendering bottlenecks, and work with art and engineering teams to improve performance. Asset Optimization: Identify and resolve performance issues related to shaders, overdraw, textures, meshes, collision, and UVs. Renderer Debugging & Profiling: Utilize GPU profiling tools like Unreal Insights, RenderDoc, or PIX to analyze and optimize render passes, overdraw, and overall performance. Tools & Automation: Build tools and scripts using Python and Unreal Engine editor utilities to automate technical workflows and support asset validation. Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with rendering engineers, technical directors, and artists to establish material standards, share best practices, and resolve technical challenges. Problem-Solving & Ownership: Take ownership of open-ended technical challenges, communicate proactively, and deliver effective solutions that balance visual quality and performance. Sound like you? This is what we're looking for: 7+ years of professional game development experience in technical art, with a focus on real-time graphics, materials, shaders, and rendering performance, including at least one shipped AAA title. Unreal Engine & PBR Expertise: Strong knowledge of UE5’s next-gen rendering pipeline including Lumen, Megalights, Grooms, Substrate, Nanite, Virtual Shadow Maps, ISMs, and GPU particle systems. Shader Development: Experience creating, debugging, and optimizing custom shaders and complex material networks, with a solid understanding of real-time rendering. Performance Profiling: Hands-on experience using tools such as Unreal Insights, RenderDoc, PIX, or GPU vendor profilers to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks. Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in Python and experience building editor tools or scripts to automate workflows and validate asset performance. Communication & Collaboration: Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with artists and engineers, explain technical concepts, and help teams resolve challenges. Independent Problem-Solving: A self-motivated approach to tackling open-ended challenges, exploring solutions, and driving work forward with minimal direction. Nice-to-haves: DCC Pipeline Experience: Experience building or improving workflows between Unreal Engine and tools such as Autodesk Maya and Substance Painter/Designer. Console Optimization: Experience profiling and optimizing performance for current-generation consoles, including PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. And here is why we think you'll love working at SkyBox: Annual bonus and up to 3% RRSP matching available Comprehensive health benefits, along with a supportive Maternity and Parental Leave policy Flexible hybrid working arrangements: leverage our beautiful studio spaces as needed and have the ability to work from home on certain projects Take care of your mental health with our Employee Assistance Program, 3 weeks of vacation leave, and our free gym at our Burnaby Studio We relentlessly support your growth and development! Level up your C++ skills at SkyBox University, explore other disciplines through our Guild Program, and expand your game dev knowledge with Lunch & Learns. You’ll join a culture of empowerment, collaboration, and personal growth. Social events! Have fun with the team at trivia nights, karaoke nights, movie nights, and various group activities. Join our soccer team, game jams, or a board game sesh after work. You name it, we’ve got it! Get involved with our diverse community through Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that champion Diversity, Equity & Inclusion initiatives and promote a supportive environment You’ll contribute to industry-leading titles! The base salary range for this position is $102,000 to $142,000. The stated pay scale reflects the range that SkyBox Labs reasonably expects to pay for this position. Your base salary and level will be determined by various factors including, but not limited to, qualifications, skills, experience, and demonstrated competencies. Our commitment to you SkyBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to developing and maintaining a diverse workforce. You’ll join a collaborative, inclusive culture where we succeed together, and like-minded people work naturally together to achieve great things (and games!). Only candidates who reside in Canada or are willing to relocate will be considered for this role. Additionally, although we appreciate all interest, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. Learn more about us at https://skyboxlabs.com/

offers.title: Rendering Technical Artist - Unpublished R&D Product
offers.description: Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience. We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints. That's where you come in. About the Role As a Senior Technical Artist, Rendering on the Unpublished R&D Product team, you will translate creative direction into scalable, performant real-time rendering solutions. You will work across materials, shaders, lighting, and rendering systems in Unreal Engine 5 (UE5), partnering with engineering, art, and design teams to address visual and technical challenges. You will help improve rendering workflows, establish technical standards, and support consistent visual quality across hardware platforms. You will report into the Tech Lead of the team. Responsibilities: Develop and implement rendering solutions that support visual direction and maintain consistency across platforms. Create, maintain, and optimize UE5 materials, shaders, and related rendering content. Partner with rendering engineers, artists, and designers to deliver rendering solutions within established performance budgets. Define rendering scalability settings, quality tiers, and fallback strategies for different hardware configurations. Profile and optimize shader performance, GPU workloads, memory utilization, and asset loading. Improve rendering workflows, technical standards, production tools, and documentation to support efficient content creation. Provide technical guidance to artists, resolve complex rendering challenges, and promote consistent rendering practices across the team. Qualifications: 5+ years of professional experience in technical art, real-time graphics, or related game development disciplines, including 4+ years working with Unreal Engine. Experience contributing rendering or technical art solutions to a shipped or long-running production project. Proficiency with UE5 material systems, shaders, and real-time rendering workflows, including the ability to read and write HLSL. Strong understanding of real-time rendering principles, lighting, material behavior, and content production workflows. Experience translating visual direction into technical rendering implementations involving materials, lighting, post-processing, or visual composition. Experience using profiling and performance analysis tools to identify and resolve GPU, shader, memory, and rendering performance issues across hardware configurations. Experience documenting technical solutions and collaborating with artists and engineers to balance visual quality, performance, and maintainability. Preferred Qualifications: Experience adapting rendering solutions across multiple platforms, including quality tiers, feature fallbacks, and performance optimization strategies. Experience developing stylized rendering solutions or rendering systems for characters, environments, visual effects, vegetation, or related visual content. Experience establishing asset standards, rendering guidelines, technical documentation, or performance budget frameworks. Experience implementing and optimizing advanced UE5 rendering features, including Lumen, Nanite, and Virtual Shadow Maps. For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

offers.title: Technical Artist (Contract)
offers.description: Nex is on a mission to help families rediscover the joy of movement. Created by parents for parents, Nex combines technology and play to deliver fun, social, and interactive experiences powered by natural body motion, encouraging kids and adults to move more, play more, and have fun together. Nex Playground, the company’s award-winning active play system, is purpose-built to get families moving year-round, with safety and privacy as core considerations in its intentional design. It is certified kidSAFE+ COPPA compliant and built to support healthy, active play for all ages and abilities. Nex Playground features a growing library of 50+ experiences, including motion and dance games, fitness and educational experiences, and Nex Originals. Content includes collaborations with partners like Hasbro, Sesame Workshop, and NBCUniversal. Nex has been recognized by Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, TIME’s Best Inventions, and Parents’ Best Entertainment System for Families, and has earned Red Dot, IDEA, and Core77 international design awards. We encourage you to explore Have Fun and Is Motion Gaming Back? , as they offer a deeper look into our culture, values, and explain how our approach to motion gaming differs from previous generations. Nex employees may be expected to collaborate with colleagues across different time zones. Depending on the role and location, occasional travel may also be required for company events, external meetings, and other business-related activities. Important Notice: ⚠️ To protect yourself from recruitment scams, please note that Nex communicates through official company emails ending in @nex.inc . If you receive a suspicious email or message, please do not respond and report it immediately to us. Location: Hong Kong Type: Full Time Contractor, with the possibility to extend or convert Reports to: UX/UI Design Manager The Role We’re looking for a highly meticulous UI Technical Artist who bridges the gap between UI/UX design and Unity implementation, with an uncompromising commitment to visual precision. In this role, you’ll bring user interfaces to life through flawless technical setup, UI motion design, and polished micro-interactions. We need a candidate who truly aims for pixel-perfect fidelity. Someone who cares deeply about aligning margins, font rendering, anchoring, and visual feedback down to the exact pixel, while maintaining a strong animation sense and high visual polish. What You'll Do Pixel-Perfect UI Implementation in Unity: Translate 2D design layouts into Unity UI with relentless accuracy, ensuring exact spacing, scale, typography, and responsiveness across varying resolutions. UI Motion & Animation Design: Design, animate, and fine-tune UI transitions, dynamic menus, and micro-interactions using Unity Timeline, Animator, Spine 2D, or tweening packages, with a sharp eye for weight, timing, and easing. Visual Feedback: Elevate the player experience by crafting crisp visual feedback using lightweight shaders (Shader Graph), UI particle systems, and subtle motion effects that feel satisfying and responsive. Precision Asset Management & Optimization: Set up dynamic anchoring, Sprite Atlases, text rendering (TextMeshPro), and UI prefabs to maintain visual perfection without compromising game performance or draw call limits. Design & Engineering Alignment: Serve as the visual quality gatekeeper by collaborating closely with UI/UX designers to honor their visual vision and working with engineers to tie UI elements into game logic seamlessly. Maintain High UI Standards: Establish robust, scalable UI structures, prefabs, and workflow guidelines that ensure consistency and visual rigor across our entire game portfolio. What We're Looking For Uncompromising Eye for Precision: A relentless commitment to pixel perfection, sharp detail, and visual accuracy when translating static or prototype designs into live, in-engine UI. Solid Unity UI Implementation Skills: Proven hands-on experience building, structuring, and optimizing UI Canvas setups in Unity. Strong Animation & Motion Sense: Deep understanding of timing, curve dynamics, and movement principles tailored specifically to menu transitions, UI states, and player feedback. Technical UI Asset Knowledge: Expertise in preparing UI assets, slice/9-grid setups, Sprite Atlases, TextMeshPro configurations, and clean prefab architecture. UI FX Capabilities: Practical experience creating UI feedback effects using particle systems, shaders (Shader Graph), or vector-based UI techniques. Nice to Have Basic scripting knowledge in C# to trigger UI animations or prototype layout behavior independently. We Offer Competitive compensation package. Flexible working hours and vacation policy. Product-driven culture that treasures talents and individual growth. Front-row seat and hands-on experience with cutting edge technologies in the evolving gaming field Nex is located in San Jose, California, USA and Hong Kong . Learn more about us at https://www.nexplayground.com/about . We encourage applications even if you don’t meet more than 50% of the requirements — we believe that experience comes in many forms! offers.description: Senior Technical Artist (Unity3D | Shaders & Tools) Location: Remote | International Team Employment: Full-Time / Long-Term Position Overview We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Artist with a strong understanding of real-time rendering, shaders, technical workflows, and game art production. We believe great technical artists are creative problem-solvers. They understand artistic intent, recognize technical constraints, and develop elegant solutions that allow artists to produce exceptional results without compromising performance or production efficiency. As part of our technical art team, you will work closely with artists, engineers, and creative leadership to develop shaders, improve workflows, troubleshoot technical challenges, and support the implementation of high-quality game art. This is a senior, hands-on role with meaningful technical ownership and opportunities to contribute to both visual quality and production technology. Key Responsibilities Shaders & Real-Time Rendering Develop and refine real-time shaders and materials that support the intended artistic direction. Work with lighting, material properties, textures, transparency, and other rendering features. Investigate rendering issues and develop practical technical solutions. Collaborate with artists to achieve visually compelling results within target platform constraints. Support the development and optimization of stylized rendering workflows. Tools & Production Pipelines Develop artist-friendly tools, scripts, validators, and workflow improvements. Improve asset import, material setup, scene organization, and content validation. Automate repetitive production tasks and reduce unnecessary manual work. Collaborate with artists to identify recurring technical challenges and build reusable solutions. Document tools and workflows to support consistency across teams. Optimization & Technical Support Profile and optimize real-time content, including geometry, materials, textures, shaders, and VFX. Identify performance bottlenecks and work with engineers to resolve them. Support platform-specific optimization requirements, including memory and GPU limitations. Troubleshoot technical art issues and maintain reliable production workflows. Help establish practical performance guidelines and technical quality standards. Collaboration & Ownership Collaborate with Art Directors, 3D Artists, VFX Artists, Lighting Artists, and Engineers. Translate artistic goals into efficient and maintainable technical implementations. Participate in technical reviews and contribute improvements to existing systems. Proactively identify technical risks and opportunities for workflow improvement. Take ownership of assigned technical art features from prototype to production. Requirements 5+ years of professional experience as a Technical Artist in game development. Experience contributing to commercially released game productions. Strong understanding of real-time rendering, materials, shaders, and graphics fundamentals. Experience with Unity3D,  or comparable real-time engines. Practical experience with Shader Graph, HLSL, custom materials, or equivalent shader workflows. Experience creating scripts, tools, or automation using Python, C#, or similar languages. Strong understanding of game art pipelines, asset preparation, and in-engine implementation. Familiarity with GPU and CPU profiling, optimization, and real-time performance constraints. Ability to troubleshoot complex artistic and technical issues. Strong artistic judgment and understanding of the relationship between visual quality and technical limitations. Excellent communication skills and fluency in English. Bonus Skills Strong Unity URP/HDRP or  rendering experience. Experience developing shaders and tools for stylized games. Knowledge of mobile GPU optimization, draw calls, overdraw, and memory budgets. Experience with Houdini or procedural content generation. Familiarity with technical animation, VFX, or character production pipelines. Experience with compute shaders or GPU-driven rendering techniques. Previous experience working in a co-development environment. What We Offer Meaningful technical ownership over shaders, tools, and production workflows. Opportunity to solve challenging artistic and technical problems. Collaboration with experienced Artists, Engineers, and Technical Leads. Remote-friendly international working environment. Competitive compensation and flexible contract options. Long-term collaboration and opportunities for professional growth. Annual Beffio team retreats and a supportive studio culture. Ready to Turn Creative Challenges into Technical Solutions? Send us your portfolio, technical breakdowns, and a short introduction. We would love to see examples of shaders, tools, optimizations, or systems you have developed and how they improved visual quality or production efficiency.

offers.title: Senior Technical Artist (Houdini | Procedural Game Art) Europe
offers.description: Senior Technical Artist (Houdini | Procedural Game Art) Location: Remote | International Team Employment: Full-Time / Long-Term Position Overview We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Artist specializing in Houdini with a passion for procedural workflows, creative problem-solving, and building scalable solutions for game art production. We believe procedural tools should do more than generate content. They should empower artists to explore ideas, create variation, maintain artistic consistency, and produce high-quality assets efficiently. In this role, you will design and develop procedural systems, tools, and production workflows that support environment art, asset creation, and other game development disciplines. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who combines deep Houdini expertise with strong artistic understanding and the ability to turn complex technical challenges into intuitive, artist-friendly solutions. Key Responsibilities Procedural Art & Houdini Development Design and develop procedural tools, generators, and systems using Houdini. Create scalable workflows for environment assets, geometry processing, modular content, and world-building tasks. Develop reusable Houdini Digital Assets (HDAs) that give artists creative control while maintaining production consistency. Build procedural systems that support artistic iteration, controlled variation, and efficient asset creation. Explore new procedural techniques that improve production quality and efficiency. Technical Art & Pipeline Integration Integrate Houdini-generated content into real-time game development workflows. Develop reliable asset export, validation, and optimization processes. Collaborate with artists and engineers to integrate procedural solutions into Unity3D, Unreal Engine, or related production pipelines. Ensure generated content meets artistic, technical, and performance requirements. Troubleshoot procedural systems, geometry issues, and pipeline bottlenecks. Tools & Automation Build artist-friendly procedural tools with clear parameters and predictable outputs. Develop workflow automation using VEX, Python, and Houdini's procedural toolset. Create reusable templates, documentation, and best practices. Prototype creative solutions and refine them into stable production tools. Improve efficiency while preserving artistic flexibility and visual quality. Collaboration & Ownership Work closely with Environment Artists, Character Artists, Technical Artists, and Engineers. Translate creative requirements into practical procedural solutions. Provide technical guidance and support artists using procedural tools. Editor Tooling & Artist Efficiency: Develop custom Unreal Engine editor tools, utility widgets, actor workflows, and workflow automations that maximize iteration speed and team efficiency for level artists and environment teams. Open World Optimization: Proven track record of optimizing complex UE5 environments and implementing content pipelines that balance high visual fidelity with strict runtime performance targets. Editor Tooling & Automation: Strong experience developing editor utility tools, custom editor interfaces, and automated workflows within Unreal Engine. Artistic Eye: A strong eye for visual quality and aesthetics, ensuring technical optimizations and automations never compromise the artistic vision. offers.title: Senior Technical Artist, Project R.I.S.E
offers.description: Great-looking games don't happen because someone drew something beautiful. They happen because someone figured out how to get that beautiful thing running at a stable framerate, on a phone, in a build the whole team can iterate on twenty times a day. That someone is you. We're looking for a Technical Artist to own the space between art and engineering on one of our new projects in the Shanghai studio. You'll be the person artists come to when the thing in Substance doesn't look like the thing in the engine, and the person programmers come to when the frame budget is blown and nobody's sure whose fault it is. You'll shape the visual identity of the game as much as any artist does — just through shaders, tooling, and pipelines rather than pixels. This is a small team with a lot of ownership. Nobody will hand you a spec. If that sounds like your kind of problem, we'd love to hear from you！ What You'll Be Doing Own the shader and material library. Author the shaders that give the game its look, design a master-material architecture artists can actually work with, and keep permutation counts and shader complexity from quietly eating the frame Build the tools artists live in. DCC scripts, engine editor extensions, one-click export, automated asset validation — every hour you save someone in Maya or the material editor goes back into the game, so treat tooling as a first-class deliverable, not a side project Raise the visual bar alongside the art team. Sit in look-dev with the art director, build the lighting and post-process templates that make the style reproducible, and close the gap between the concept on the wall and the thing running on device Keep art content within budget. Profile real builds on real phones, work out why the device is getting hot, and design the LOD and quality-tier systems that let the game scale from flagship to low-end without losing its identity Prototype the risky visual ideas. Before anyone commits to them, and be honest about which ones won't survive contact with the frame budget Be the interface to the engine team. Translate what artists want into renderer features programmers can scope, and translate what the renderer does into constraints artists can work with Set and hold the standards. Define how art content should be built, document it, onboard people onto the pipeline, and be the person who notices when things start slipping What You Have 8+ years in games, a meaningful chunk of it on the technical side of art Real shader authoring skill — HLSL, Unreal's material graph, or both — and enough scripting (Python, Blueprint, or C++) to build your own tools rather than request them A working mental model of how a frame gets rendered, and of where Unreal's content pipeline hides its costs Fluency across the DCC stack (Maya, Blender, Houdini, Substance, or your equivalents) and strong opinions about how they should connect to the engine The instinct to profile before optimizing, and the patience to chase a regression to its actual cause Comfort being the translation layer between two disciplines that don't always speak the same language — and the diplomacy that takes A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge Being a great teammate — we believe making games is a team sport Would Be Nice if You Also Have At least one shipped mobile title, and the scars to prove it — thermal throttling, bandwidth ceilings, memory budgets, the whole set A history of extending the Unreal editor when the existing workflow wasn't good enough Hands-on experience with AI agents and AI-assisted workflows, especially pointed at content or tooling problems Experience across the full arc of a project, from grey-box prototype to live service, and a sense of what matters at each stage Where You'll Be This role is based in our Shanghai office. If you are not local, our relocation team would be excited to help you with your move to Shanghai,China. We provide comprehensive support not only for you, but also for your family! ––– That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read. Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page. ––– About Supercell Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, Brawl Stars, and Squad Busters . Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever. So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects. The Shanghai studio As Supercell’s first international game development studio, the Shanghai studio is one of the most exciting things happening in Supercell and a unique opportunity to join at a relatively early stage to help shape our path. Our vision is to be a world-class international studio, making new global hit games while leveraging the unique advantages of the game development scene in China and broader Asia. Hey, you Might Love It Here! Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture . But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way. You Are Not Your Job Title ™ Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here. Benefits and Compensation Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource. Relocation? Yes! No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind! Not sure if you should apply? Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process. Wishing you all the best, The Supercell Recruitment team P.S. Here's a video about what we do. (Best enjoyed with salmiakki and rye bread)

offers.title: Unity Technical Artist, Event Pipeline
offers.description: Help us ship new 3D immersive events and content to the VRChat community, reliably, efficiently, and with a high quality bar. Join the VRChat team! We’re building the future of immersive, user-generated worlds, where anyone, anywhere, can connect, play, explore, and express themselves. We’re looking for a Unity Technical Artist to support VRChat’s live ops events and content pipeline. This role sits at the intersection of art and engineering: you’ll be hands-on in Unity, you’ll write scripts/tools to make publishing more efficient, and you’ll help our events and content ship smoothly across platforms. You’ll partner closely with artists, designers, and engineers, so creative work moves from “done” to “shipped” without surprises. What You'll Do Own and evolve the end-to-end Unity content pipeline for live ops assets, helping us ship 3D props and content updates with consistency and speed. Implement and validate 3D assets in Unity: prefabs, materials, shaders, collisions, LODs, lighting setups, and import settings, with an eye toward performance and reliability. Build and maintain tools, scripts, and automation (primarily in C# and Udon) that reduce manual work, prevent common errors, and make publishing repeatable. Create lightweight quality gates for content: asset validation checks, naming/structure conventions, performance budgets, and “ready to ship” checklists. Debug content and pipeline issues across disciplines, working with engineers on technical constraints and with artists on asset readiness. Collaborate with Product Design and Creators partners to ensure content supports the intended user experience and meets our quality bar. Document workflows so the whole team can move faster as we scale content volume in 2026. Who You Are You have 3+ years experience as a Technical Artist, Tools Artist, or similar role (or equivalent shipped work). You’re deeply comfortable in Unity and understand what it takes to ship real-time 3D content that performs well. You can write scripts (most likely C# ) and you’ve built tools or automation that helped teams move faster or reduced production risk. You understand 3D fundamentals (meshes, materials, textures, lighting, optimization) and can collaborate effectively with artists on asset quality. You think in systems and pipelines: you notice recurring failure modes, then design guardrails that prevent them. You communicate clearly across disciplines and enjoy being the person who turns ambiguity into a reliable workflow. You have a strong ownership mindset: you care about shipping, not just “building a perfect tool someday.” Bonus Points (Not required, but we’d be excited if you bring any of the following!) Experience building editor tooling, import automation, or asset validation pipelines in Unity. Familiarity with the VRChat creator toolchain: Unity + VRChat SDK (Worlds/Avatars) + Creator Companion (VCC/VPM) Experience building interactivity in VRChat worlds using Udon / UdonSharp (C# that compiles to Udon) Familiarity with common VRChat avatar components like PhysBones/Contacts and performance best practices. Experience optimizing content for multiple hardware tiers and platforms (PC + mobile constraints, etc.). Experience supporting live ops or high-cadence content publishing. Not sure if you meet every single requirement? We’d still love to hear from you. We know technical artists come from all kinds of backgrounds. If you’re excited to help ship a steady stream of 3D content to a global community, and you like making pipelines fast, safe, and human-friendly, please apply. Where You’ll Be This is a remote-first role. Work from wherever you do your best thinking. We’re a fully distributed company with team members across the globe. While we work asynchronously, overlap with U.S. time zones is needed for team collaboration. Benefits 100% Remote – work from anywhere in the world Health benefits for U.S. and Canadian employees 401K (U.S.) and RRSP (Canada) retirement plans Stock options Unlimited/flexible vacation policy Paid parental leave Generous holiday schedule VRChat is an equal-opportunity employer, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. VRChat fosters a diverse, creative, and collaborative environment where anyone can contribute to any of the ongoing projects or direction of the roadmap at any time.  If you’re a passionate team player who wants to have an impact on a dynamic team, we’d love to hear from you! All job offers are subject to early stage ID checks, satisfactory referencing and background checks.

You’ll have the autonomy to make decisions, the trust to run with a design spec, and the creative freedom to solve problems your way.
