offers.title: VFX Artist match-3 | Mobile | Remote
offers.description: About the Role We are partnering with an established mobile games studio to find a highly skilled and visionary Senior VFX Artist specializing in Match-3 animation to help shape the visual identity of their upcoming and live mobile titles. In this role, you will serve as a cornerstone of the art team, balancing hands-on VFX and animation creation with high-level style exploration. You will partner closely with the Creative Director to define the look-development and motion feel for core Match-3 gameplay elements, characters, and environments, translating creative visions into clear, actionable documentation for internal and external teams. Key Responsibilities Lead VFX and animation look-development, iterating on diverse stylized art directions to establish a cohesive, satisfying aesthetic for new and live Match-3 and casual mobile titles. Produce high-quality 2D and real-time VFX, animated sprite sheets, booster effects, and color/lighting keys for core gameplay elements, environments, and characters to set the visual benchmark for the project. Draft comprehensive VFX design briefs, animation style guides, and technical breakdown documents that clearly define rendering techniques, lighting, timing, and shape language. Establish and maintain project design and animation review boards using digital whiteboarding platforms such as FigJam or Miro to streamline the review pipeline and facilitate cross-discipline alignment. Provide actionable artistic feedback and ensure all visual effects and animated assets align with established visual pillars, small-screen readability, and Match-3 mobile gameplay mechanics. Requirements 4+ years of VFX and animation experience in the gaming industry, with a shipped portfolio demonstrating Senior-level work specifically in mobile games (Casual, Match-3, or Merge game experience is a strong plus). Demonstrated ability to explore and adapt to various art styles, with a deep understanding of mobile readability, color theory, animation timing, and small-screen constraints. Proven experience creating visual guides, VFX/animation breakdown documents, and asset briefs that can be easily interpreted by 3D modelers, UI artists, and external outsourcing partners. Mastery of Photoshop or equivalent digital painting and animation software for crafting hand-drawn/stylized FX textures and flipbooks, alongside comfort with visual collaboration tools (Miro, FigJam) for organizing references and feedback. Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate artistic choices and advocate for visual quality. Bonus Qualifications Familiarity with 3D software (such as Blender, Maya, or ZBrush) for creating 3D FX meshes, base block-outs, paintovers, or assisting in the transition from 2D concepts to the 3D production pipeline. Professional proficiency or fluency in Mandarin Chinese to facilitate seamless communication with the internal team.

offers.title: Technical Artist, Pokémon GO
offers.description: ​​Pokémon GO is the global gaming sensation that has been downloaded over 1 billion times and named “Best Mobile Game” by the Game Developers Choice Awards and “Best App of the Year” by TechCrunch. Pokémon GO follows Scopely Explore’s mission of encouraging outdoor exploration, exercise, and significant social interactions, and has grossed over $6B in revenue since its debut in 2016. In order to delight our millions of players across the globe, the Pokémon GO team requires motivated and skilled individuals to develop new features and look for creative ways to optimize a continually growing game. We are seeking a Technical Artist with creative and technical expertise to help across a variety of live-game challenges and features. This is a hybrid role, with three days per week on-site at our Tokyo studio. You will work with cross-functional partners and bridge technical and creative aspects of game development. You will leverage your curiosity and passion for mobile games to develop best in class game features. Responsibilities Collaborate with art, design, engineering, and product teams to build features and solve creative problems. Build rapid prototypes of experimental features using Unity 3D or other mobile platform tools. Iterate on Unity 3D scene implementation to finalize product and creative requirements. Create performant graphics shaders for beautiful visuals. Facilitate communication and collaboration between art and engineering. Leverage AI to accelerate prototyping, content creation, and problem-solving while maintaining quality and sound judgment. Qualifications 3+ years as a Technical Artist or similar role. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills. Experience in Python, C#, or similar scripting languages. Experience in modern 3D game engines such as Unity 3D. Knowledge of optimization and performance profiling of real-time 3D content and pipelines for mobile platforms. Knowledge of generative AI tools and utilization in Tech Art workflows such as prototyping and tooling. Familiarity across multiple areas of Tech Art such as animation, graphics, pipelines and tooling, scripting gameplay, etc. Experience in agentic AI workflows that amplify your Technical Art skills, with the ability to read, debug, and explain AI-generated work. Professional-level English for daily verbal and written communication. Plus If... BS or MS degree in design, games-related or technical field. Solid artistic skills (color, shape, light, motion). Experience collaborating within a multi-person game studio. Experience writing shaders (HLSL or GLSL). Experience developing tools for artists or designers. Fluency in Japanese. About Scopely Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play. Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come. Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play. offers.title: 2D/3D Animation & VFX Artist (Mid-Senior)
offers.description: Job Description We are looking for a talented 2D/3D Animation & VFX Artist to bring our mobile games to life through engaging animations and visual effects. In this role, you will create 2D and 3D animations, develop real-time visual effects, and integrate your work into our Unity/Cocos2d-x-based projects. Working closely with artists, game designers, and developers, you will contribute to the visual identity of our games and enhance the overall player experience. We are looking for a team player who can take ownership of their work from concept to implementation and optimization, creating high-quality assets that align with the game's art direction and mobile performance requirements. What You'll Do Create 2D and 3D animations for characters, objects, and in-game elements. Set up 2D rigs in Spine, create animations, and integrate them into the game engine. Create character and object animations using Blender, Maya, or equivalent 3D software, and adapt existing animations when needed. Design stylized, real-time visual effects for in-game events, rewards, and transitions. Create UI animations that support game menus, progression systems, and player feedback. Integrate animations and visual effects into Unity/Cocos2d-x projects and collaborate with developers on any required technical adjustments. Ensure animations and effects enhance gameplay timing, clarity, and responsiveness. Optimize animations and effects for mobile devices while maintaining a balance between visual quality and performance. Create well-organized, reusable assets and contribute to improving production workflows. Take ownership of assigned tasks, track progress, and refine deliverables based on feedback. What We're Looking For 3-5+ years of professional experience in game animation and/or real-time VFX, supported by a portfolio showcasing your animation and visual effects work. Strong hands-on experience with rigging, skinning, and 2D skeletal animation in Spine. Proficiency in Blender, Maya, or equivalent 3D software, particularly in animation and rigging workflows. Experience working with Unity or Cocos2d-x, including the integration of animations, particle systems, and visual effects into game engines. A solid understanding of fundamental animation principles, including timing, anticipation, weight, and follow-through. A strong artistic eye for stylized movement, color, composition, and visual clarity. Experience creating real-time effects that complement gameplay and the overall art direction of a project. Understanding of mobile performance limitations and the ability to optimize assets accordingly. Ability to plan and deliver tasks in line with production timelines. Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to both give and receive constructive feedback. Good written and spoken English skills. Nice to Have Experience working on published mobile games or live-operated game projects. Knowledge of shaders, materials, and real-time rendering workflows. Experience creating VFX textures, sprite sheets, and flipbook animations. Proficiency in Photoshop, After Effects, or similar tools. Experience creating cinematic sequences. Basic knowledge of C# or C++ to support animation and VFX integration. Experience improving production workflows and sharing knowledge with other artists. How to Apply Please submit your CV along with a portfolio or showreel showcasing your 2D/3D animation and real-time VFX work. We are particularly interested in seeing examples of Spine animations, 3D character or object animations, and visual effects implemented in Unity/Cocos2d-x. For collaborative projects, please clearly highlight your individual contributions. offers.title: Senior Technical Artist - 12 Month Contract
offers.description: Description d3t is at the forefront of videogame technology and creativity, delivering experienced co-development services to some of the biggest AAA clients in the world. Our studio, part of the global Keywords Studios Group, works on multiple exciting projects at any one time, offering plenty of variety and involvement. Our studio projects have included EA SPORTS FC™ 26, Hogwarts Legacy, Exoborne, Mafia: The Old Country, Alan Wake Remastered, Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy, LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, Vampire The Masquerade - Blood Hunt, Mafia II: Definitive Edition, and Assetto Corsa Competizione. We also work in partnership with our global clients including: Playground Games, EA and Archetype Entertainment. The d3t studios are based near Daresbury (Cheshire), Newcastle (Tyne & Wear) and Madrid (Spain) where we offer an amazingly professional and supportive working environment. We are passionate about what we do and pride ourselves on our anti-crunch mentality, mentoring ethos and have been awarded 'Best Places to Work' multiple times by gamesindustry.biz. In addition, we won 'Best Creative Service Provider' at Develop 2022 and were nominated in 2023 & 2024. This opportunity will be a 12 month fixed-term contract (with possible extension) based in either of our UK studio sites (Daresbury or Newcastle), on a hybrid working basis ideally. Working pattern - 3 days per week in the studio: Wednesday, Thursday and another day of your choice. We will also consider fully remote working too. d3t's Art team blends technical excellence with a passion for the craft of game development. Our expertise spans the full development cycle-from co-development on features and content to benchmark creation and work on remakes / remasters. We deliver world-class content across Environment, Character, VFX, and Animation. We don't just create art; we build the tools and pipelines that power it. We are expanding our studio and looking for a Senior Technical Artist to help us redefine what's possible. The Role - Senior Technical Artist: What are we looking for? Establish and maintain project art pipelines from inception and throughout the project life-cycle. Support the art and animation team requirements and assist with resolving technical issues. Creating and integrating in-house toolsets and creation of materials/shaders Ensure all artwork hits memory and frame rate guidelines/restrictions by means of performance profiling. Collaborate with the artists and feedback on how they can improve the performance of the in-game assets while maintaining visual fidelity. Able, when required, to take ownership of specific features of the game. Ensure all artwork adheres to guidelines regarding naming conventions, texture layering structures etc Keep up to date with industry advancements and technologies and share knowledge with the art team. Add to our library of tutorials, documents and technical guides to improve efficiency in the art pipeline and be proactive in finding solutions to technical issues. With a professional and organised approach, you adhere to schedules and promptly feedback concerns regarding any aspects of the project. Ensuring the right tasks are tackled in the right order, updating Jira, communicating progress and helping to manage team deliverables. Advise the Technical Art Leadership of resourcing concerns and production risks. Encourage and mentor other members of the Technical Art Team. Self driven, autonomous and confident, demonstrate responsibility for work quality and processes for both yourself and other members of the tech art team, actively contributing fresh ideas and encouraging the team. Confident with motivating Tech Artists, inspire colleagues to flourish and help promote a culture of collaborative innovation. Requirements Essential Skills: Enjoy the technical challenge and constraints of real-time game art and have some understanding of modern rendering, shading and lighting techniques. Must be performance and quality focused. Must have an excellent working knowledge and proficiency in Maya and/or 3DS Max and an excellent in-depth knowledge in Python. Excellent communication and organisation skills and confident working within a multidisciplinary art team. Evidence of being an enthusiastic leader or role model in intermediate art role Able to create materials/shaders and a good understanding of a PBR workflow. Excellent understanding of the technical limitations of current console hardware. Practical and methodical approach to technical and creative problem-solving. Demonstrate dependability and commitment to projects and tasks, and a hunger to learn and improve as a Technical Artist. Flexible and calm approach with the ability to adapt to change. Ability to deliver quality work within fixed time constraints. Strong knowledge of modern game engines such as Unreal Engine Or Unity. Excellent knowledge of current game development practices and terminology and a passion for staying up to date with latest technology and embracing new game art techniques. Desirable Skills: Knowledge of other scripting languages is advantageous. Knowledge of the Maya API and programming in C++ or C# is advantageous Some understanding of various other tools and software used in development, Photoshop, Substance, Houdini etc is also advantageous. We work flexibly, but value in-person collaboration: this position is offered on a hybrid basis at either of our UK sites (3 days per week working in the studio: Wednesday, Thursday and another day of your choice). We will also consider remote working too for this role. We value a work/life balance and have a discretionary flexible hours system and operate a no-crunch policy as a studio. Benefits d3t Studio Benefits & Perks: 22 days holiday +3 Festive Studio Closure + Bank Holidays Company Pension Scheme Flexible Working Hours Private Medical Insurance Scheme - BUPA Anti-crunch ethos - a professional, fun and supportive working environment! Free Parking Company Socials, Monthly Lunches + Annual d3t Events Breakout Areas - filled with perks such as games, BBQ area, complimentary snacks to suit all dietary preferences etc. First interviews will be help by video call, followed by second interviews on-site. Don't meet every single requirement? Not a problem - please apply. At d3t we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and culture. If this opportunity excites you but your current skills or past experience don't align perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to still apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles within our team.

offers.title: Senior Technical Artist - Vic/SA/Qld
offers.description: Keywords Studios is a global provider of creative and technical services to the video games industry, with over 13,000 professionals across 70+ studios in 25+ countries. We support clients across the entire game lifecycle through four core Service Lines: Create - Game development, art production, and audio Globalize - Localization, localization QA, functional testing Engage - Marketing, LiveOps, community, and player support Media & Entertainment We're constantly working with some of the worlds largest Publishers and most popular AAA games. Here in Australia we have studios located in Adelaide, Brisbane and Melbourne and employ about two hundred of Australia's leading game professionals. Our studio brands operating under the Keywords Studios group are Wicked Workshop (Vic) and Tantalus Media (Vic, SA, Qld). This position can be based in either Adelaide, Brisbane, or Melbourne. The role of Senior Technical Artist drives the efficiency of the art production pipeline, acting as the critical bridge between the creative vision of the Art team and the technical constraints of Engineering. This role is responsible for developing internal tools and workflows, creating and optimising complex materials and shaders, and ensuring content meets high visual quality while maintaining performance budgets. The ideal candidate is technically proficient, possesses strong problem-solving and communication skills, and works proactively to research, implement, and document technical solutions across the entire development team. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES OWNERSHIP & RENDERING Design, implement and maintain complex in-engine materials, shaders, and lighting setups to achieve the game's aesthetic goals while strictly adhering to rendering budgets. Establish and enforce technical specifications for all art content, personally overseeing the integration, performance profiling and validation of assets across the entire project. Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks related to geometry, draw calls and lighting to ensure the project maintains high frame rates and stability on target platforms. Assist the Art team with asset creation or technical implementation in various domains (e.g., character setup, lighting, environment) outside your immediate area of expertise when needed. PIPELINE ENGINEERING & OPTIMISATION Develop, iterate on, and maintain robust tools, scripts, and processes that streamline content authoring within DCC packages and the game engine, with an emphasis on improving team productivity and user experience. Lead the advancement of the art production pipeline, ensuring smooth and stable data flow and technical integrity between all relevant software (e.g., Maya, Blender, Substance) and the game engine. Collaborate closely with Engineering and other Technical Artists to maintain and continuously improve shared project and studio tools, code libraries, and established workflows. CROSS-DISCIPLINE COLLABORATION Act as the primary technical liaison between the Art, Design, and Engineering teams, translating artistic requirements into technical specifications and engineering limitations into actionable art goals. Serve as the go-to for the Art and Animation teams, providing prompt technical support, troubleshooting complex bugs, and resolving pipeline blockages. Actively share learnings, best practices, and new tools across the studio, mentoring mid-level and junior artists on efficient and technically sound production methods. DOCUMENTATION & RESEARCH Create and maintain clear, up-to-date technical documentation on all tools, workflows, best practices and established art specifications. Proactively identify technical debt and potential future production risks, proposing, testing and documenting long-term technical solutions. Maintain an active awareness of emerging technologies, engine updates, and industry trends to ensure the studio's technical art practices remain competitive and efficient. Approximately 5-7 years of professional experience in the games industry. Strong foundational knowledge of the art pipeline, an artistic eye and practical experience in art and animation content creation. Demonstrated skills and interest across multiple technical domains: Shader development, VFX / Particles, Pipeline and tool development, and Real-time physics simulations. Proven proficiency in scripting and coding in one or more core languages Current, hands-on development experience with modern commercial game engines. Strong foundational knowledge in at least one industry DCC package (Maya, 3ds Max, Blender, Adobe Suite) and advanced skills in at least one relevant development package (Houdini, EmberGen, After Effects, or Substance suite). Strong attention to detail, excellent time management, problem-solving, and highly effective communication skills. DESIRABLE SKILLS Previous production experience working on the demands and complexities of AAA game development. Familiarity with console development, including platforms like Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, and Xbox. Expertise and interest in one or more advanced areas: Character rigging, Procedural asset generation, Lighting, Real-time rendering and post-effects, or asset optimisation and performance profiling. Familiarity with specific programming interfaces, such as the Maya API. Skills in traditional art, drawing, painting, or photography. offers.description: チーム紹介/About the Hiring Team ライトスピード• ジャパンは,世界中のオーディエンス向けにオリジナルのAAA級アクションゲームタイトルの制作に特化しているゲーム開発スタジオです。著名なゲームディレクターとして知られる伊津野英昭(いつの ひであき)が率いる当スタジオは,東京と大阪の2つの拠点で活動しています。 柔軟で包括的な職場環境を提供し,ゲーム制作の限界を押し広げる才能と情熱にあふれるゲームクリエイターの参加を非常に歓迎しています。 LightSpeed Japan Studio is a game development studio dedicated to crafting original AAA action game titles for global audiences. Led by industry veteran Hideaki Itsuno, the studio operates across two locations in Tokyo and Osaka. The studio offers a flexible and inclusive work environment and actively welcomes game creators who are full of talent and passion for pushing the boundaries of game development. 仕事内容/What the Role Entails 仕事内容 モーションTAとして,アニメーターをサポートし,アニメーション品質の向上を目指します。 具体的な業務内容は以下の通りです: ①Control Rig,Animation Blueprint,Motion Matching,Ragdollなどの技術を活用し,ゲーム内のキャラクターアニメーションの品質を向上させます。 プレイヤーが操作時に感じる即時的なレスポンスを実現しつつ,動作が自然かつリアルに見えるようにします。 ②さまざまなフェイシャル技術を検証し,最適なソリューションを選定することで,カットシーンにおける表情表現の品質を次世代AAAレベルまで引き上げます。 ③モーションキャプチャに関連する技術的な課題に対してサポートを提供します。 Job Description As a Motion Technical Artist (Motion TA), you will support animators and aim to improve the quality of animations. Your specific responsibilities will include: 1. Enhancing in-game character animation quality by utilizing technologies such as Control Rig, Animation Blueprint, Motion Matching, and Ragdoll. offers.title: Technical Artist
offers.description: Description Keywords Studios is currently looking to expand its team in Southeast Asia. We're currently looking for an accomplished, enthusiastic, and self-motivated Technical Artist to join our team working on an exciting, new, and unannounced project. Keywords Studios is a global leader providing art services to AAA Publishers. Our work can be seen across many of the top-selling titles on console, PC and mobile. You'll get to work alongside seasoned developers bringing expertise from world-class AAA studios. These opportunities can be located in Malaysia, Indonesia, or Vietnam (Remote). Sponsorship and relocation are not being offered as part of this package. A Technical Artist at Keywords Studios: Creates and maintains tools, scripts and pipelines that help the art team produce high-quality visual content efficiently. Works closely with artists, designers, engineers and other technical experts to identify technical issues, improve workflows and support production needs. Helps the art team communicate technical requirements and constraints to the development team. Solves technical challenges creatively to maximise visual quality while staying within real-time performance and hardware limitations. Supports the creation, optimisation and implementation of complex visual content, including materials, shaders, procedural assets and VFX. Prototypes, develops, profiles and implements procedural VFX, including particles, post-processing effects, shaders and related visual systems. Contributes to pipeline development, optimisation and best practices across content creation, integration and performance. Drives the creation of complex procedural and physically based content, helping ensure assets are efficient, scalable and production-ready. Requirements Proven experience as a Technical Artist or similar role on a commercial game development project. Strong understanding of real-time art production, optimisation, pipeline development and technical problem-solving. Proficiency in scripting and other languages such as MAXScript, MEL, C#, Python, HLSL, GLSL. Good artistic eye, with the ability to balance visual quality, technical constraints and performance requirements. Experience with VFX, materials, shaders, lighting models, tool development, optimisation and pipeline development. Experience working with modern game engines such as Unreal Engine, Unity or proprietary engines. Experience with art production tools such as Photoshop, Houdini, Substance Painter, Substance Designer, Maya or 3DS Max. Familiarity with source control workflows, ideally Perforce. Ability to work collaboratively across disciplines and iterate quickly based on feedback. Benefits Our Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) Commitment: Keywords Studios is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, ethnicity, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. If you require any adjustments during the process, please let us know in your application. We are committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion, respect and integrity, customer focus, and innovation. We especially welcome applications from candidates of underrepresented groups in the industry. PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION POLICY By providing your information in this application, you understand that we will collect and process your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information, please see our Applicant Privacy Notice at https://www.keywordsstudios.com/en/applicant-privacy-notice. offers.title: Technical Artist - 12 Month Contract (Madrid, Spain)
offers.description: Description d3t is at the forefront of videogame technology and creativity, delivering experienced co-development services to some of the biggest AAA clients in the world. Our studio, part of the global Keywords Studios Group, works on multiple exciting projects at any one time, offering plenty of variety and involvement. Our studio projects have included EA SPORTS FC™ 26, Hogwarts Legacy, Exoborne, Mafia: The Old Country, Alan Wake Remastered, Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy, LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, Vampire The Masquerade - Blood Hunt, Mafia II: Definitive Edition, and Assetto Corsa Competizione. We also work in partnership with our global clients including: Playground Games, EA and Archetype Entertainment. The d3t studio for this opportunity is based in Madrid, Spain where we offer an amazingly professional and supportive working environment. We also have studios in the UK (Daresbury, Cheshire and Newcastle, Tyne & Wear). We are passionate about what we do and pride ourselves on our anti-crunch mentality, mentoring ethos and have been awarded 'Best Places to Work' multiple times by gamesindustry.biz. In addition, we won 'Best Creative Service Provider' at Develop 2022 and were nominated in 2023 & 2024. This Technical Artist opportunity will be a 12 month fixed term contract (with possible extension) based on-site in the Madrid studio, working on a hybrid working basis. The hybrid working pattern will be - minimum 3 days per week in the studio: Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday. d3t's art team blends technical excellence with a passion for the craft of game development. Our expertise spans the full development cycle-from co-development on features and content to benchmark creation and work on remakes / remasters. We deliver world-class content across Environment, Character, VFX, and Animation. We don't just create art; we build the tools and pipelines that power it. We are expanding our studio and looking for a Technical Artist to help us redefine what's possible. The Role - Technical Artist: What are we looking for? Responsible for helping to establish and maintain project art pipelines from inception and throughout the project life-cycle. Support the art and animation team requirements and assist with resolving technical issues. Assist with creating and integrating in-house toolsets and be involved in creating materials/shaders. Ensure all artwork hits memory and frame rate guidelines/restrictions by means of performance profiling. Collaborate with the artists and feedback on how they can improve the performance of the in-game assets while maintaining visual fidelity. Ensure all artwork adheres to guidelines regarding naming conventions, texture layering structures etc. Keep up to date with industry advancements and technologies and share knowledge with the art team. Add to our library of tutorials, documents and technical guides to improve efficiency in the art pipeline and be proactive in finding solutions to technical issues. Advise the Senior Technical Artist of resourcing concerns and production risks. Encourage and mentor other members of the Technical Art Team. Requirements Essential skills: Enjoy the technical challenge and constraints of real-time game art and have some understanding of modern rendering, shading and lighting techniques. Must be performance and quality focused. Must have an excellent working knowledge and proficiency in Maya and/or 3DS Max and an excellent in-depth knowledge in Python. Strong communication and organisation skills and confidence working within a multidisciplinary art team. Good understanding of the technical limitations of current console hardware. Practical and methodical approach to technical and creative problem-solving. Demonstrate dependability and commitment to projects and tasks, and a hunger to learn and improve as a Technical Artist. Flexible and calm approach with the ability to adapt to change. Ability to deliver quality work within fixed time constraints. Good knowledge of current game development practices and terminology and a passion for staying up to date with latest technology and embracing new game art techniques Desirable skills: Knowledge of other scripting languages is advantageous. Knowledge of the Maya API and programming in C++ or C# is advantageous Some understanding of various other tools and software used in development, Photoshop, Substance, Houdini etc is also advantageous. Knowledge of Unreal Engine or Unity is advantageous. Knowledge of materials/shaders and a good understanding of a PBR workflow. At least 1 published title. We work flexibly, but value in-person collaboration: this position is offered on a hybrid basis in the Madrid studio (3 days per week in the studio). We value work/life balance and have a discretionary flexible hours system and operate a no-crunch policy as a studio. Benefits d3t Studio Benefits & Perks: 22 days holiday +3 Festive Studio Closure + Bank Holidays Company Pension Scheme Flexible Working Hours Private Medical Insurance Scheme - BUPA Anti-crunch ethos - a professional, fun and supportive working environment! Free Parking Company Socials, Monthly Lunches + Annual d3t Events Breakout Areas - filled with perks such as games, BBQ area, complimentary snacks to suit all dietary preferences etc. Interviews will be help by video call. Don't meet every single requirement? Not a problem - please apply. At d3t we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and culture. If this opportunity excites you but your current skills or past experience don't align perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to still apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles within our team.

offers.title: Lead VFX Artist
offers.description: Si quieres trabajar en una empresa española dedicada al desarrollo de videojuegos AAA, consolidada como un referente en el desarrollo internacional, ¡sigue leyendo! En MercurySteam contamos con un equipo multidisciplinar orientado a la innovación técnica y al desarrollo de propiedad intelectual propia. Nuestro objetivo es crear los mejores videojuegos mientras disfrutamos del proceso de hacerlos. Queremos dejar un legado de videojuegos excepcionales para los jugadores y de vivencias únicas para quienes los desarrollan, sin perder nuestra independencia creativa y manteniéndonos fieles a nuestra visión y forma de crear. Requisitos mínimos: • Experiencia liderando equipos de VFX en proyectos de videojuegos. • Experiencia en desarrollo de VFX en tiempo real con UnrealEngine y/o Unity (sistemas de partículas, materiales, etc.). • Experiencia con Photoshop/Substance Designer; capacidad de crear texturas de forma autónoma y con calidad profesional para ser aplicadas en VFXs. • Saber aplicar principios artísticos para efectos visuales en tiempo real: composición, formas, color, iluminación, animación, etc... • Experiencia demostrable en el desarrollo de videojuegos AAA. • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y colaboración interdisciplinar. • Habilidades para gestionar personas y proporcionar feedback claro. Requisitos deseados: • Conocimiento de programación de shaders. • Manejo de herramientas para creación de efectos prerenderizados como Houdini, Embergen o similares. • Conocimiento de algún lenguaje de scripting (MaxSript/Python/etc.…) y/o programación (C++). • Pasión por los videojuegos. Responsabilidades: • Liderar, gestionar y desarrollar al equipo de VFX, fomentando un ambiente de trabajo colaborativo. • Planificar, priorizar y distribuir las tareas del equipo en base a las necesidades de producción y del proyecto. • Coordinarse con el resto de equipos para integrar los efectos correctamente. • Participar en procesos de selección, entrevistas, onboarding y desarrollo del equipo. • Identificar riesgos, bloqueos y necesidades de recursos proponiendo soluciones. • Revisar el trabajo del equipo para garantizar la calidad artística y técnica. • Impulsar la mejora de herramientas y workflows del departamento. Beneficios: - Ambiente de trabajo colaborativo y flexible, con oportunidades de desarrollo y crecimiento. - Horario flexible de entrada (8:00 - 10:00am.) - Dispondrás de hasta 23 días de teletrabajo al año. - Dispondrás de 23 días de vacaciones a libre disposición y además, cierre temporal del estudio en navidad, con esos días incluidos como parte de tus vacaciones. - Salario acorde a experiencia y capacidades. - Seguro médico privado. - Mejoramos constantemente nuestras herramientas y procesos para que puedas centrarte en la creatividad. - Hacemos juegos AAA con un gran componente artesanal en el que todos los integrantes del equipo contribuyen activamente. Nuestro compromiso Creemos en la igualdad de oportunidades y en el respeto como base de cualquier proyecto sólido. Fomentamos un entorno donde todas las personas, independientemente de su género, identidad o expresión de género, orientación sexual, edad, nacionalidad, religión o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley, puedan desarrollarse plenamente. Todas las candidaturas serán evaluadas sin discriminación por discapacidad, garantizando un proceso de selección basado exclusivamente en las competencias profesionales. Fomentamos la inclusión de personas con certificado de discapacidad igual o superior al 33%. Si te ilusiona formar parte de un estudio que apuesta por la excelencia, las personas y el legado creativo, queremos conocerte Contacto Si quieres formar parte de nuestro equipo, envíanos tu CV y enlace a tu porfolio/reel a: jobs_hr@mercurysteam.com Asunto: Lead VFX Artist - Nombre candidato/a Todas las muestras recibidas se considerarán confidenciales.

offers.title: Colaboración Artista de Animación y VFX (3D)
offers.description: COLABORACIÓN POR REVENUE SHARE Estudio indie en activo busca programador/a para incorporarse como colaborador/a por revenue share a un videojuego comercial actualmente en desarrollo. El proyecto: Tower Defense de estrategia en tiempo real con cartas en Unreal Engine 5 llamado “The Heart of Anathema”. offers.description:

En Cofrico somos especialistas en el diseño, instalación y mantenimiento de sistemas de refrigeración industrial, comercial y climatización, con una sólida trayectoria en el desarrollo de soluciones basadas en refrigerantes naturales como el amoníaco (NH₃) y el CO₂ . Trabajamos en proyectos de frío industrial de gran envergadura para sectores como la industria alimentaria, pesquera y logística frigorífica , con instalaciones que incluyen centrales frigoríficas de NH₃, sistemas en cascada NH₃/CO₂, plantas enfriadoras, túneles de congelación, cámaras frigoríficas industriales y sistemas de refrigeración de procesos productivos. Apostamos por la innovación, la eficiencia energética y la sostenibilidad, incorporando tecnologías avanzadas como Gradhoc , nuestra solución de monitorización y optimización energética, que nos permite mejorar el rendimiento de las instalaciones y avanzar hacia un mantenimiento predictivo. ¿A quién buscamos? Queremos incorporar a nuestro equipo de Vigo un/a Técnico/a Frigorista Industrial con experiencia en instalaciones de amoníaco (NH₃) , que disfrute del trabajo técnico, la resolución de averías y los retos que plantean las instalaciones frigoríficas industriales. Buscamos una persona con autonomía, capacidad de diagnóstico y compromiso con la seguridad y la calidad del servicio, que quiera seguir desarrollándose en una empresa especializada en refrigeración industrial. ¿Qué harás en tu día a día? Realizar el mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo de instalaciones frigoríficas industriales , principalmente con refrigerante NH₃. Diagnosticar y resolver averías mecánicas, eléctricas y de funcionamiento en centrales frigoríficas y equipos industriales. Intervenir en instalaciones con compresores industriales, evaporadores, condensadores, bombas, válvulas y sistemas de regulación y control. Supervisar el funcionamiento de las instalaciones, verificando parámetros de operación, rendimiento y condiciones de seguridad. Realizar ajustes y actuaciones técnicas para garantizar la fiabilidad, continuidad operativa y eficiencia energética de los sistemas. Colaborar con el equipo técnico en la identificación de mejoras y optimización de las instalaciones. ¿Qué te ofrecemos? Estabilidad laboral: contrato indefinido y un proyecto profesional a largo plazo. Especialización y desarrollo profesional: trabajarás con instalaciones de frío industrial y tecnologías de refrigeración con refrigerantes naturales, punteras a nivel nacional. Formación continua: contarás con el apoyo de nuestro equipo de soporte técnico SAT, formado por profesionales con amplia experiencia en instalaciones frigoríficas industriales. Horario de lunes a viernes , de 08:00 a 17:30 hrs. Furgoneta de empresa para los desplazamientos laborales. Media dieta diaria y dieta completa, cuando sean necesarias por desplazamientos. Requisitos ¿Qué buscamos en ti? Experiencia previa en mantenimiento de instalaciones de refrigeración industrial con amoníaco (NH₃). Este es el requisito principal de la posición. Conocimientos sólidos de sistemas frigoríficos industriales y sus componentes. Capacidad para diagnosticar averías y trabajar de forma autónoma en instalaciones industriales. Valoraremos especialmente: Experiencia con compresores de tornillo y alternativos, sistemas de NH₃ bombeado, circuitos de glicol y sistemas en cascada NH₃/CO₂. Experiencia en instalaciones frigoríficas de la industria alimentaria, pesquera o logística. Titulación de Técnico Superior en mantenimiento de Instalaciones Térmicas y de Fluidos, ó Técnico en Montaje y Mantenimiento de Instalaciones de Frío, Climatización y Producción de calor, ó IMAR0108, u otra formación equivalente habilitante a la profesión de frigorista. Contar con el carnet de manipulación de gases fluorados sin límite de carga (actualizado al 2017). Carnet de conducir (permiso B). Inscribirme Cofrico

offers.title: Técnico/a Electromecánico Servicio Campo de Fabricante Motores Industriales (Indefinido)
offers.description:
- Ejecutar el diagnóstico, mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo de motores diésel y de gas de gran tonelaje, tanto en aplicaciones terrestres (plantas de energía/cogeneración) como marinas (buques).
- Realizar ajustes complejos electromecánicos y calibraciones en los sistemas de control de los equipos.
- Interpretar planos, diagramas y esquemas mecánicos, eléctricos y electrónicos propios de la tecnología del fabricante.
- Evaluar el estado técnico de los componentes del motor, emitiendo recomendaciones técnicas de reparación o mejora.
- Coordinar las intervenciones in situ con el cliente y verificar el cumplimiento riguroso de la normativa de seguridad y HSE (Health, Safety & Environment).
- Cumplimentar partes de trabajo y reportes técnicos a través de la plataforma interna (SAT-Land), registrando datos de calibración, mediciones e incidencias.
- Prestar apoyo técnico operativo al equipo en paradas programadas y averías críticas a nivel peninsular e internacional cuando se requiera refuerzo. Requisitos del puesto: - Formación académica: Formación Profesional de Grado Medio o Superior en Electromecánica, Mecatrónica Industrial, Automoción o formación/experiencia equivalente en el sector Náutico/Naval.
- Experiencia laboral: 3 años de experiencia demostrable en mantenimiento industrial y reparación de motores diésel o de gas de gran tonelaje.
- Conocimientos técnicos: Dominio de la lectura de esquemas electromecánicos y capacidad para realizar ajustes en sistemas de control.
- Movilidad y licencias: Carnet de conducir B y vehículo propio inicial. Disponibilidad total para viajar a nivel nacional (base operativa en A Coruña/Galicia y Norte de Portugal) e internacional.
- Disponibilidad operativa: Flexibilidad para trabajar en régimen de bloques (14 días con 12 de trabajo y 2 de descanso). Formación: Ciclo Formativo Grado Medio

 Conocimientos: Resolución proactiva de incidencias
 Experiencia: 5 años

Tus beneficios: Retribución fija atractiva: Salario base de 29.000 ¿ brutos anuales en 14 pagas.
- Complementos y pluses:
                - Plus de disponibilidad inicial de 4.000 euros/año (cubre los primeros 15 retenes).
                - Complemento por fin de semana trabajado de 97 euros por sábado y 97 euros por domingo.
                - Bolsa de incentivos/objetivos de aprox. 900 euros semestrales (a partir del primer año).
                - Variable grupal del 4% del salario según objetivos de la compañía.
                - Dieta y alojamiento: Sistema de dietas (78 euros/día en dieta completa nacional, 128 euros en Portugal, 158 euros en otros destinos internacionales) y alojamiento garantizado en hoteles de 4 estrellas mínimo (habitación individual).

- Jornada y descanso: Contratación bajo Convenio Colectivo del Metal de Tarragona (1.744 horas/año) con sistema de descanso acumulado inmediatamente.
